text: Buku paliang awal nan dikatahui di dunia ditulih dalam bahaso Sanskerta. Sasudah panyusunan Upanisad, bahaso Sanskerta mailang hanyo karano hierarki.
eng_text: The earliest known book in the world was written in Sanskrit. After the compilation of Upanishads, Sanskrit just faded due to hierarchy.

text: Bahaso Sanskerta adolah bahaso nan rumik jo kayo bana, nan alah bajaso manjadi sumber dari banyak bahaso India moderen, samo jo bahaso Latin sabagai asanyo bahaso-bahaso Eropa sarupo bahaso Parancis jo Spanyol.
eng_text: Sanskrit is a very complex and rich language, which has served to be the source for many modern Indian languages, just like Latin is the source for European languages like French and Spanish.

text: Dek parang Parancis alah salasai, Jerman mulai basiap manyarang Pulau Baritania.
eng_text: With the battle for France over, Germany began to get ready to invade the island of Britain.

text: Kode namo sarangan Jerman tu adolah “Operasi Singo Lauik”. Banyak sanjato barek jo pabakalan angkatan darek Tantara Inggirih ilang katiko disalamaikan dari Dunkirk, sahinggo tantaranyo cukuik lamah.
eng_text: Germany code-named the attack “Operation Sealion”. Most of the British Army's heavy weapons and supplies had been lost when it evacuated from Dunkirk, so the army was fairly weak.

text: Tapi, Angkatan Lauik Karajaan masih labiah kuek dibandiangan jo Angkatan Lauik Jerman (“Kriegsmarine”) dan dapek maancuan sado armada Jerman nan dikirim malintasi Selat Inggirih.
eng_text: But the Royal Navy was still much stronger than the German Navy (“Kriegsmarine”) and could have destroyed any invasion fleet sent across the English Channel.

text: Namun, kapa Angkatan Lauik Karajaan nan bamarkas condoang dakek jo rute invasi karano laksamananyo takuik ka ditanggalaman jo sarangan udaro Jerman.
eng_text: However, very few Royal Navy ships were based near the likely invasion routes as the admirals were afraid they would be sunk by German air attack.

text: Molah awak mulai dari panjalehan rancana Italia. Italia utamonyo adolah sabagai "adiak" Jerman jo Japang.
eng_text: Let's start with an explanation about Italy's plans. Italy was mainly the "little brother" of Germany and Japan.

text: Italia punyo tantara jo angkatan lauik nan labiah lamah, walau pun alah inyo buek ampek kapa baru tapek sabalum parang dimulai.
eng_text: It had a weaker army and a weaker navy, although they had just built four new ships right before the beginning of the war.

text: Tujuan utamo Italia adolah nagara-nagara Afrika. Untuak marabuik nagara-nagara tu, Italia paralu punyo landasan paluncua pasukan, sahinggo maso pasukan dapek balayia malintasi Lauik Mediterania dan manyarang Afrika.
eng_text: Italy's main goals were African countries. To capture those countries, they would need to have a troop launching pad, so as troops could sail across the Mediterranean Sea and invade Africa.

text: Untuak itu, Italia harus manyingkiaan pangkalan dan kapa Inggirih di Mesir. Salain itu, kapa parang Italia ndak saharusnyo mangarajoan nan lain.
eng_text: For that, they had to get rid of British bases and ships in Egypt. Besides those actions, Italy's battleships were not supposed to do anything else.

text: Samantaro kini Japang. Japang adolah nagara kapulauan, bantuak Baritania.
eng_text: Now for Japan. Japan was an island country, just like Britain.

text: Kapa salam adolah kapa nan dibuek untuak parjalanan di bawah lauik dan manatap di situ untuak waktu panjang nan lamo.
eng_text: Submarines are ships designed to travel underwater, and remain there for an extended amount of time.

text: Kapa salam dipakai dalam Parang Dunia I jo Parang Dunia II. Pado maso dulu tu jalannyo lambek bana dan jarak tembaknyo sangaik tabateh.
eng_text: Submarines were used in World War I and World War II. Back then they were very slow and had a very limited shooting range.

text: Pado mulo parang, kapa salam banyak bajalan di ateh lauik, tapi maso radarnyo mulai bakambang dan labiah tapek, kapa salam tapaso pai ka bawah aia buliah indak kadapekan.
eng_text: In the beginning of the war they mostly travelled on top of the sea, but as radar began developing and becoming more accurate the submarines were forced to go under water to avoid being seen.

text: Kapa salam Jerman namonyo U-Boats. Urang Jerman pandai maarahan dan manjalanan kapa salamnyo.
eng_text: German submarines were called U-Boats. The Germans were very good at navigating and operating their submarines.

text: Karano kapa salamnyo barasia, sasudah parang pun Jerman indak dipicayokan untuak punyo kapa salam nan banyak.
eng_text: Because of their success with submarines, after the war Germans aren't trusted to have many of them.

text: Raja Tutankhamun kadang disabuik jo "King Tut" atau "The Boy King", nan manjadi salah satu rajo Mesir kuno nan paliang tanamo di jaman kini.
eng_text: Yes! King Tutankhamun, sometimes referred to as "King Tut" or "The Boy King", is one of the most well known ancient Egyptian kings in modern times.

text: Manariknyo, inyo indak dianggap pantiang di zaman kuno dan indak tatulih di daftar raja kuno.
eng_text: Interestingly, he was not considered to be very important in ancient times and was not recorded on most ancient king lists.

text: Namun, panamuan makamnyo pado taun 1922 mambueknyo jadi takenal. Samantaro makam lain banyak nan dimaliang, makam iko indak tagaduah hampia dipadiaan.
eng_text: However, the discovery of his tomb in 1922 made him a celebrity. While many tombs of the past were robbed, this tomb was left virtually undisturbed.

text: Sabagian gadang barang nan dikubua jo Tutankhamun alah dipaliaro elok-elok, tamasuak ribuan artefak nan tabuek dari logam mulia jo batu langka.
eng_text: Most of the items buried with Tutankhamun have been well preserved, including thousands of artefacts made from precious metals and rare stones.

text: Panamuan jeruji roda mambuek kareta Asiria labiah ringan, kancang, dan labiah siap untuak balari labiah capek daripado tantara dan kareta lainnyo.
eng_text: The invention of spoke wheels made Assyrian chariots lighter, faster, and better prepared to outrun soldiers and other chariots.

text: Panah dari busua nan mamatian dapek manembus baju basi tantara lawan. Sakitar 1000 SM, urang Asiria mangenalan kavalri partamo.
eng_text: Arrows from their deadly crossbows could penetrate the armor of rival soldiers. About 1000 B.C., the Assyrians introduced the first cavalry.

text: Kavaleri adolah pasukan nan baparang sambia manunggang kudo. Palano alun ditamuan dulu, jadinyo kavaleri Asiria baparang di ateh pungguang kudo talanjang.
eng_text: A cavalry is an army that fights on horseback. The saddle had not yet been invented, so the Assyrian cavalry fought on the bare backs of their horses.

text: Awak tau jo banyak urang politisi, cadiak pandai, jo seniman Yunani. Kamungkinan urang nan paling tanamo dari budayo ko adolah Homer, pujanggo legendaris nan buto, nan marangkai duo karya sastra Yunani, Puisi Iliad dan Odyssey.
eng_text: We know many Greek politicians, scientists, and artists. Possibly the most known person of this culture is Homer, the legendary blind poet, who composed two masterpieces of Greek literature: the poems Iliad and Odyssey.

text: Sophokles jo Aristofanes adolah dramawan tanamo dan dramanyo dianggap sabagai salah satu karya sastra hebat dunia.
eng_text: Sophocles and Aristophanes are still popular playwrights and their plays are considered to be among the greatest works of world literature.

text: Urang Yunani tanamo lainnyo adolah matematikawan Pythagoras, nan takenal laweh karano teorema takenalnyo manganai hubuangan sisi sagitigo siku-siku.
eng_text: Another famous Greek is a mathematician Pythagoras, mostly known for his famous theorem about relations of the sides of right triangles.

text: Ado babagai pakiroan untuak barapo banyak urang nan manutuaan bahaso Hindi. Dipakiroan bahaso tu ado di antaro bahaso nan paliang banyak ditutuaan nomor duo dan nomor ampek di dunia.
eng_text: There are varying estimates for how many people speak Hindi. It is estimated to be between the second and fourth most commonly spoken language in the world.

text: Jumlah panutua asli baragam bagantuang jo apokah iyo atau indak dialek-dialek nan dakek bana hubuangannyo taituang juo.
eng_text: The number of native speakers varies depending on whether or not very closely related dialects are counted.

text: Pakiroan panutuanyo bakisar dari 340 juta sampai 500 juta urang, dan sabanyak 800 juta urang dapek mangarati bahaso tu.
eng_text: Estimates range from 340 million to 500 million speakers, and as many as 800 million people can understand the language.

text: Bahaso Hindi jo Urdu ado kamiripan di kosa kato tapi babeda di panulisannyo; dalam parcakapan sahari-hari, panutua kaduo bahaso ko biasonyo bisa saliang mangarati.
eng_text: Hindi and Urdu are similar in vocabulary but different in script; in everyday conversations, speakers of both languages can usually understand each other.

text: Sakitar abaik ka 15, Estonia utaro ado di bawah pangaruah gadang budayo Jerman.
eng_text: Around the 15th century, northern Estonia was under great cultural influence of Germany.

text: Babarapo biarawan Jerman nio mambao Tuhan supayo dakek ka panduduak asli, sainggo urang tu manciptaan bahaso harpiah Estonia.
eng_text: Some German monks wanted to bring God closer to the native people, so they invented the Estonian literal language.

text: Bahaso tu badasarkan uruf bahaso Jerman dan ciek karakter "Õ/õ" nan ditambahan.
eng_text: It was based on the German alphabet and one character "Õ/õ" was added.

text: Sairiang bajalannyo wakatu, banyak kato-kato nan dipinjam dari bahaso Jerman gabuangan. Hal iko manjadi awal pancarahan.
eng_text: As time passed, many words that were borrowed from German coalesced. This was the beginning of enlightenment.

text: Sacaro taradisional, ahli warih dari tahta tu ka langsuang masuak militer sasudah manyalasaian sakola.
eng_text: Traditionally, the heir to the throne would go straight into the military after finishing school.

text: Namun, Charles masuak universitas di Trinity College, Cambridge di mano inyo baraja Antropologi jo Arkeologi, dan kamudian Sajarah, maasiakan 2:2 (paringkek kaleh paliang randah nomer duo).
eng_text: However, Charles went to university at Trinity College, Cambridge where he studied Anthropology and Archaeology, and later History, earning a 2:2 (a lower second class degree).

text: Charles adolah anggota partamo Kaluarga Karajaan Inggirih nan diagiah gala sarjana.
eng_text: Charles was the first member of the British Royal Family to be awarded a degree.

text: Turki Eropa (wilayah Thrace timur atau Rumelia di samananjuang Balkan) tamasuak 3% dari nagara tu.
eng_text: European Turkey (eastern Thrace or Rumelia in the Balkan peninsula) includes 3% of the country.

text: Wilayah Turki panjangnyo labiah dari 1.600 kilometer (1.000 mil) jo lebanyo 800km (500 mil), jo bantuak nan kurang labiah sarupo pasagi panjang.
eng_text: The territory of Turkey is more than 1,600 kilometres (1,000 mi) long and 800 km (500 mi) wide, with a roughly rectangular shape.

text: Area Turki, nan tamasuak danau-danau, manampati 783.562 kilometer persegi (300.948 mil persegi), nan di Asia barat daya salaweh 755.688 kilometer persegi (291.773 mil persegi) dan di bagian Eropa 23.764 kilometer persegi (9.174 mil persegi).
eng_text: Turkey's area, including lakes, occupies 783,562 square kilometres (300,948 sq mi), of which 755,688 square kilometres (291,773 sq mi) are in south west Asia and 23,764 square kilometres (9,174 sq mi) in Europe.

text: Area Turki manjadikannyo nagara nomor 37 paliang laweh di dunia, dan kiro-kiro salaweh gabuangan Parancis Metropolitan jo Baritania Rayo.
eng_text: Turkey's area makes it the world's 37th-largest country, and is about the size of Metropolitan France and the United Kingdom combined.

text: Turki dikaliliangi jo lauik di tigo sisi: Lauik Aegean di baraik, Lauik Itam di utaro dan Lauik Mediterania di salatan.
eng_text: Turkey is encircled by seas on three sides: the Aegean Sea to the west, the Black Sea to the north and the Mediterranean Sea to the south.

text: Luksemburg punyo sajarah nan panjang tapi kamardekaannyo sajak 1839.
eng_text: Luxembourg has a long history but its independence dates from 1839.

text: Bagian Belgia hari-ko marupoan bagian dari Luksemburg di maso lalu namun manjadi Belgia sasudah Revolusi Belgia pado 1830.
eng_text: Present-day parts of Belgium were part of Luxembourg in the past but became Belgian after the 1830s Belgian Revolution.

text: Luksemburg salalu mancubo untuak tatap manjadi nagara netral namun nyo ditampeki di Parang Dunia I dan Parang Dunia II oleh Jerman.
eng_text: Luxembourg has always tried to remain a neutral country but it was occupied in both World War I and World War II by Germany.

text: Pado 1957 Luksemburg manjadi anggota panagak organisasi nan hari ko awak katahui sabagai Parsatuan Eropa.
eng_text: In 1957 Luxembourg became a founding member of the organization which is today known as the European Union.

text: Drukgyal Dzong adolah runtuahan benteang dan biaro Buddha di bagian ateh distrik Paro (di Desa Phondey).
eng_text: The Drukgyal Dzong is a ruined fortress and Buddhist monastery in the upper part of the Paro District (in Phondey Village).

text: Disabuikan pado 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel mambuek bentenang untuak mamparingati kamanangannyo malawan kakuatan Tibet-Mongol.
eng_text: It is said that in 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel created the fortress to commemorate his victory against the Tibetan-Mongol forces.

text: Pado 1951, kabakaran hanyo manyisoan babarapo paninggalan dari Drukgyal Dzong, bantuak lukisan Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.
eng_text: In 1951, a fire caused for only some of the relics of the Drukgyal Dzong to remain, such as the image of Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.

text: Sasudah kabakaran, benteang tu dipaliaro dan dilinduangi, manjadi ciek atraksi Bhutan nan paliang sensasional.
eng_text: After the fire, the fortress was preserved and protected, remaining to be one of Bhutan's most sensational attractions.

text: Di abaik 18 Kamboja manamuan dirinyo takapik diantaro duo jiran nan kuek, Thailand dan Vietnam.
eng_text: During the 18th century Cambodia found itself squeezed between two powerful neighbors, Thailand and Vietnam.

text: Urang Thai manyarang Kamboja babarapo kali di abaik ka 18 dan di 1772 urang tu maancuan Phnom Phen.
eng_text: The Thais invaded Cambodia several times in the 18th century and in 1772 they destroyed Phnom Phen.

text: DI tahun akia dari abaik ka 18 urang Vietnam juo manyarang Kamboja.
eng_text: In the last years of the 18th century the Vietnamese also invaded Cambodia.

text: Lapan baleh persen dari urang Venezuela adolah pangangguran, dan kabanyakan dari urang nan indak manganggur bakarajo di parekonomian informal.
eng_text: Eighteen percent of Venezuelans are unemployed, and most of those who are employed work in the informal economy.

text: Duo patigo urang Venezuela nan bakarajo di bagian jaso, ampia saparampeknyo bakarajo di industri jo sapalimo bakarajo di patanian.
eng_text: Two thirds of Venezuelans who work do so in the service sector, nearly a quarter work in industry and a fifth work in agriculture.

text: Industri pantiang untuak urang Venezuela adolah minyak, dima nagari tu adolah eksportir barasiah, walau hanyo sapersen nan bakarajo di industri minyak.
eng_text: An important industry for Venezuelans is oil, where the country is a net exporter, even though only one percent work in the oil industry.

text: Labiah awal di kamardekaan bangsa tu, kaahlian Taman Botani Singapur mambantu marubah pulau tu manjadi Kota Taman tropis.
eng_text: Early in the nation's independence, Singapore Botanic Gardens' expertise helped to transform the island into a tropical Garden City.

text: Pado 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, sabuah anggrek kawin silang, dipiliah sabagai bungo nasional bangsa.
eng_text: In 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, an orchid hybrid, was chosen as the nation's national flower.

text: Satiok taun sakita Oktober ampia 1.5 juta herbivora bapajalanan manuju dataran di salatan, manyubarang Batang Mara, dari pabukitan di utaro untuak mancari hujan.
eng_text: Every year around October nearly 1.5 million herbivores travel towards the southern plains, crossing the Mara River, from the northern hills for the rains.

text: Dan kamudian baliak ka utaro malalui barat, sakali lai manyubarang Batang Mara, sasudah hujan sakita bulan April.
eng_text: And then back to the north through the west, once again crossing the Mara river, after the rains in around April.

text: Wilayah Serengeti baisi Taman Nasional Serengeti, Area Konservasi Ngorongoro dan Suaka Margasatwa Maswa di Tanzania dan di Cagar Alam Maasai Mara di Kenya.
eng_text: The Serengeti region contains the Serengeti National Park, the Ngorongoro Conservation Area and Maswa Game Reserve in Tanzania and the Maasai Mara National Reserve in Kenya.

text: Baraja untuak mambuek media interaktif mambutuahan kamampuan konvensional dan tradisional, baitu juo jo alaik nan dikausai di kelaih interaktif (papan carito, maedit audio jo video, manyampaian carito, dll.)
eng_text: Learning to create interactive media requires conventional and traditional skills, as well as tools mastered in interactive classes (storyboarding, audio and video editing, story telling, etc.)

text: Desain interaktip mamaraluan dunsanak untuak maninjau ulang soal asumsi tantang produksi media dan baraja untuak bapikia jo caro nan indak linier.
eng_text: Interactive design requires that you re-assess your assumptions about media production and learn to think in a non-linear ways.

text: Desain interaktif mamaraluan komponen dari sabuah proyek nan baubuangan satu samo lain, tapi juo masuak aka sabagai kahadiran nan tapisah.
eng_text: Interactive design requires that components of a project connect to each other, but also make sense as a separate entity.

text: Karugian dari lensa zoom adolah kompleksitas fokus dan sajumlah elemen lensa diparaluan untuak mancapai jarak dari panjang jarak fokus nan labiah gadang daripado untuak lensa utamo.
eng_text: The disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the focal complexity and number of lens elements required to achieve a range of focal lengths is much greater than for prime lenses.

text: Hal iko manjadi masalah nan indak baitu bana sabagai pambuek lensa nan mancapai standar nan tinggi dalam pambuatan lensa.
eng_text: This is becoming less of an issue as lens manufacturers achieve higher standards in lens production.

text: Hal iko mambuek lensa zoom bisa mambuek gambar bakualitas sabandiang jo nan dicapai lensa jo jarak pokus nan tatap.
eng_text: This has allowed zoom lenses to produce pictures of a quality comparable to that achieved by lenses with fixed focal length.

text: Karugian nan lain dari lensa zoom adolah apertur maksimal (kakancangan) lensa biasonyo labiah randah.
eng_text: Another disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the maximum aperture (the speed) of the lens is usually lower.

text: Hal iko mambuek lensa zoom murah labiah sulik untuak digunoan di kondisi cahayo-randah tanpa lampu kilek.
eng_text: This makes inexpensive zoom lenses hard to use in low-light conditions without a flash.

text: Salah satu masalah paliang umum katiko mangubah pilem ka bantuak DVD adolah overscan.
eng_text: One of the most common problems when trying to convert a movie to DVD format is the overscan.

text: Kabanyakan tipi dibantuak untuak maibua masarakaik banyak.
eng_text: Most televisions are made in a way to please the general public.

text: Dengan alasan itu, segala sesuatu yang kamu lihat di TV memilik batasan, di atas, di bawah, dan di samping
eng_text: For that reason, everything you see on the TV had the borders cut, top, bottom and sides.

text: Iko dibantuak untuak mamastian gambar bisa manutuik kasadoalahan layar. Itu disabuik overscan.
eng_text: This is made to ensure that the image covers the whole screen. That is called overscan.

text: Sayangnya, ketika kamu membua DVD, batasannya kemungkinan besar akan dipotong juga, dan jika video memiliki subtitle terlalu dekat ke bawah, mereka tidak akan ditampilkan sepenuhnya.
eng_text: Unfortunately, when you make a DVD, it's borders will most likely be cut too, and if the video had subtitles too close to the bottom, they won't be fully shown.

text: Istano tradisional jaman patangahan alah lamo mainspirasi imajinasi, manyulap gambar pataruangan, jamuan makan jo kesatria Arthurian.
eng_text: The traditional medieval castle has long inspired the imagination, conjuring up images of jousts, banquets and Arthurian chivalry.

text: Walaupun tagak di antaro runtuahan nan baumua ribuan taun, taraso bana suaro jo baun dari paparangan nan alah lamo tiado, kamudian raso tadanga suaro darok kuku di ateh babatuan dan tacium katakuikan nan kalua dari lubang pinjaro bawah tanah.
eng_text: Even standing amidst thousand year-old ruins it is easy to bring to mind the sounds and smells of battles long gone, to almost hear the clatter of hooves on the cobbles and to smell the fear rising from the dungeon pits.

text: Tapi apokah angan-angan wak badasarkan kanyataan? Baa kok istano-istano tu dibuek awalnyo? Baa nyo dirancang jo dibangun?
eng_text: But is our imagination based on reality? Why were castles built in the first place? How were they designed and built?

text: Umum untuak jaman tu, Kastil Kirby Muxloe labiah ka rumah nan dibenteangi daripado kastil sasungguahnyo.
eng_text: Typical for the period, Kirby Muxloe Castle is more of a fortified house than a true castle.

text: Kaco tingkok nan gadang dan dindiang tipih mungkin indak akan bisa manahan sarangan taruih-manaruih untuak wakatu nan lamo.
eng_text: Its large glazed windows and thin walls would not have been able to resist a determined attack for long.

text: Pado taun 1480, katiko pambangunannyo dimulai jo Lord Hastings, nagari tu relatif aman dan partahanan hanyo dibutuahan untuak malawan kalompok ketek parampok kaliliang.
eng_text: In the 1480s, when its construction was begun by Lord Hastings, the country was relatively peaceful and defense was only required against small bands of roving marauders.

text: Kasaimbangan kakuatan adolah sistem di mano nagara-nagara Eropa barusaho untuak mampatahankan kadaulatan nasioal kasado nagara Eropa.
eng_text: The balance of power was a system in which European nations sought to maintain the national sovereignty of all European states.

text: Konsepnyo adolah bahaso kasado nagara Eropa harus barusaho untuak mancagah satu nagara manjadi kuaik, dan dek baitu pamarintah nasional acok maubah aliansinyo untuak manjago kasaimbangan.
eng_text: The concept was that all European nations had to seek to prevent one nation from becoming powerful, and thus national governments often changed their alliances in order to maintain the balance.

text: Parang Suksesi Spanyol manandai parang partamo nan isu utamonyo adolah kasaimbangan kakuasaan.
eng_text: The War of Spanish Succession marked the first war whose central issue was the balance of power.

text: Nanko manandoi parubahan pantiang, karano kakuatan Eropa indak mamiliki daliah lai manjadi parang agamo. Dek baitu, Parang Tigo Puluah Taun ka manjadi parang pangabisan nan dicap sabagai parang agamo.
eng_text: This marked an important change, as European powers would no longer have the pretext of being religious wars. Thus, the Thirty Years' War would be the last war to be labeled a religious war.

text: Kuil Arthemis di Afesus dihancuakan pado 21 Juli 356 Sabalum Masehi, dalam aksi pambakaran nan dilakukan dek Herostratus.
eng_text: The temple of Artemis at Ephesus was destroyed on July 21, 356 BCE in an act of arson committed by Herostratus.

text: Manuruik carito, motivasinyo adolah katanaran jo caro apo pun. Urang Afesus berang, maumumkan bahaso namo Herostratus indak pernah dicataik.
eng_text: According to the story, his motivation was fame at any cost. The Ephesians, outraged, announced that Herostratus' name never be recorded.

text: Sajarawan Yunani Strabo kamudian mancataik namo tu, nan kito kana kini. Kuil tu dihancuakan pado malam nan samo Alexander Agung lahia.
eng_text: The Greek historian Strabo later noted the name, which is how we know today. The temple was destroyed on the same night that Alexander the Great was born.

text: Alexander, sabagai rajo, manawaran untuak mambayia mambuek ulang kuil, tatapi tawarannyo ditulak. Kamudian, sasudah Alexander maningga, kuil ko dibangun ulang pado taun 323 SM.
eng_text: Alexander, as king, offered to pay to rebuild the temple, but his offer was denied. Later, after Alexander died, the temple was rebuilt in 323 BCE.

text: Pastianlah tangan dunsanak satanang mungkin samantaro masih manakan sado not tu sacaro tapek – cubo juo untuak indak mambuek garak nan ganjia jo jari-jari dunsanak.
eng_text: Make sure your hand is as relaxed as possible while still hitting all the notes correctly - also try not to make much extraneous motion with your fingers.

text: Jo caro ko, dunsanak ka mambuek panek surang saketek mungkin. Ingeklah indak ado paralunyo manakan tuts jo dayo kareh untuak bunyi labiah pado piano tu.
eng_text: This way, you will tire yourself out as little as possible. Remember there's no need to hit the keys with a lot of force for extra volume like on the piano.

text: Pado akordion, untuak mandapek bunyi labiah kancang, dunsanak pakailah nan bawah jo labiah manakannyo atau mangancangannyo.
eng_text: On the accordion, to get extra volume, you use the bellows with more pressure or speed.

text: Mistisisme adolah pancarian komuni jo, identitas jo, atau kasadaran dari kanyatoan tatinggi, kailahian, kabanaran spiritual, atau Tuhan.
eng_text: Mysticism is the pursuit of communion with, identity with, or conscious awareness of an ultimate reality, divinity, spiritual truth, or God.

text: Urang nan baiman mancari suatu pangalaman langsuang, intuisi, atau ilham dalam kanyatoan ilahi/dewa atau dewa-dewi.
eng_text: The believer seeks a direct experience, intuition, or insight into divine reality/the deity or dieties.

text: Pangikuik manuntuik caro-caro iduik tatantu, atau pangamalan nan dimukasuikan untuak mamaliaro pangalaman-pangalaman tu.
eng_text: Followers pursue certain ways of living, or practices that are intended to nurture those experiences.

text: Mistisisme dapek dibedaan dari bantuak kayakinan agamo lain dan disambah jo panakanannyo pado pangalaman pribadi langsuang dari kaadaan kasadaran nan istimewa, khususnyo nan damai, mandalam, bahagia, atau bahkan basipaik manyanangkan.
eng_text: Mysticism can be distinguished from other forms of religious belief and worship by its emphasis on the direct personal experience of a unique state of consciousness, particularly those of a peaceful, insightful, blissful, or even ecstatic character.

text: Sikhisme adolah agamo dari anak banua India. Iko barasa dari wilayah Punjab salamo abaik ka-15 dari papacahan kalompok dalam taradisi Hindu.
eng_text: Sikhism is a religion from the Indian sub-continent. It originated in the Punjab region during the 15th century from a sectarian split within the Hindu tradition.

text: Sikh bapandangan kayakinannyo manjadi agamo tapisah dari Hinduisme walau inyo mangakui pokok jo tradisi Hindunyo.
eng_text: Sikhs consider their faith to be a separate religion from Hinduism though they acknowledge its Hindu roots and traditions.

text: Sikhs mamanggia agamanyo Gurmat, nan adolah bahaso Punjab untuak "jalannyo guru". Guru adolah aspek paliang dasar dari sado agama India tatapi dalam Sikhisme alah mambao kapantiangan nan mambantuak inti kayakinan Sikh.
eng_text: Sikhs call their religion Gurmat, which is Punjabi for "way of the guru". The guru is a fundamental aspect of all Indian religions but in Sikhism has taken on an importance that forms the core of Sikh beliefs.

text: Agamo ko dibuek pado abaik ka-15 dek Guru Nanak (1469-1539). Nan dilanjuikan dek sambilan guru sacaro baturuik-turuik.
eng_text: The religion was founded in the 15th century by Guru Nanak (1469–1539). There followed in succession a further nine gurus.

text: Walau pun baitu, pado bulan Juni 1956, janji Krushchev’s dipatanyoan katiko tajadi karusuhan di Polandia, nan mano para pakarajo nan mamprotes kakurangan bahan makanan jo pangurangan upah, barubah manjadi protes taadok Komunisme.
eng_text: However, in June 1956, Krushchev's promises were put to the test when riots in Poland, where workers were protesting against food shortages and wage cuts, turned into a general protest against Communism.

text: Paradapan Lambah Indus ko adolah paradapan Zaman Parunggu nan barado di baraik lauik anak banua India nan maliputi sabagian gadang Pakistan maso kini jo babarapo wilayah di baraik lauik India jo timua lauik Afganistan.

eng_text: Attention Deficit Disorder "is a neurological syndrome whose classic defining triad of symptoms including impulsivity, distractibility, and hyperactivity or excess energy".

text: Hal itu bukanlah katidakmampuan baraja, itu adolah gangguan baraja; ADD ko "mampangaruahi 3 sampai 5 parsen sado anak-anak, mungkin sabanyak 2 juta anak Amerika".
eng_text: It is not a learning disability, it is a learning disorder; it "affects 3 to 5 percent of all children, perhaps as many as 2 million American children".

text: Anak-anak jo ADD punyo kasulitan mamusekan paratian ka hal-hal sarupo karajo sakolah, tapi inyo dapek bakonsentrasi ka hal-hal nan inyo sanang lakukakn sarupo bamain game atau manonton pilem kartun kasukoannyo atau manulih kalimaik tanpa tando baco.
eng_text: Children with ADD have a hard time focusing on things like school work, but they can concentrate on things they enjoy doing like playing games or watching their favorite cartoons or writing sentences without punctuation.

text: Anak-anak ko condoang talibek banyak masalah, karano inyo "punyo parangai barisiko, ikuik bacakak, dan malawan otoritas" supayo untuak marangsang utaknyo, karano utaknyo indak dapek dirangsang jo caro biaso.
eng_text: These children tend to get into a lot of trouble, because they "engage in risky behaviors, get into fights, and challenge authority" in order to stimulate their brain, since their brain can not be stimulated by normal methods.

text: ADD badampak ka hubuangannyo jo kawan sasamonyo karano anak lain indak dapek paham apo alasan inyo balaku jo caro inyo buek atau apo alasan inyo maeja jo caronyo atau tingkaik kadewasaannyo babeda.

eng_text: Unlike other primates, hominids no longer use their hands in locomotion or bearing weight or swinging through the trees.

eng_text: Army ant colonies march and nest in different phases as well.

text: Pado maso bapindah, pasukan samuik bapawai katiko malam, sarato baranti untuak bamukim salamo siang hari.
eng_text: In the nomadic phase, army ants march at night and stop to camp during the day.

text: Koloni tu mamulai tahap bapindah katiko makanan nan tasadio alah bakurang. Salamo tahap ko, koloni mambuek sarang samantaro nan dituka-tuka satiok hari.
eng_text: The colony begins a nomadic phase when available food has decreased. During this phase, the colony makes temporary nests that are changed everyday.

text: Satiok sarangan atau pawai nan bapindah-pindah ko balangsuang salamo kiro-kiro 17 ari.
eng_text: Each of these nomadic rampages or marches lasts for approximately 17 days.

text: Apo sel tu? Kato sel barasa dari kato bahaso Latin "cella", nan bararti "ruang ketek", nan partamo kali diutarokan dek salah surang mikroskopis nan sadang mangamati struktur dari sumbek boto.
eng_text: What is a cell? The word cell comes from the Latin word "cella", meaning "small room", and it was first coined by a microscopist observing the structure of cork.

text: Sel adolah bagian dasar dari sagalo makhluk iduik, sagalo makhluk iduik tadiri dari ciek sel atau labiah.
eng_text: The cell is the basic unit of all living things, and all organisms are composed of one or more cells.

text: Sel sangaiklah mandasar sarato sangaik pantiang untuak palajaran tantang kahidupan, kanyatoannyo, sampai-sampai sel acok disabuik sabagai "balok panyusun kahidupan".
eng_text: Cells are so basic and critical to the study of life, in fact, that they are often referred to as "the building blocks of life".

text: Susunan Saraf maomalihar homeostasis jo maantan ransangan saraf ka saluruah badan untuak manjago aliran darah bajalan lanca indak tagaduah.
eng_text: The Nervous System maintains homeostasis by sending nerve impulses through out the body to keep the flow of blood going as well as undisturbed.

text: Ransangan-ransangan saraf ko dapek dikirim sangaik capek ka saluruah badan nan mambantu manjago badan salamaik dari satiok kamungkinan ancaman.
eng_text: These nerve impulses can be sent so quickly throughout the body which helps keep the body safe from any potential threat.

text: Tornado mahantam sabuah daerah nan ketek dibandiangan jo badai nan marusak lainnyo, tapi tornado bisa mambuek ancua apo sajo nan ado diadokannyo.
eng_text: Tornadoes strike a small area compared to other violent storms, but they can destroy everything in their path.

text: Tornado manumbangan batang kayu, maurak papan dari bangunan, jo mancampakan oto ka langik. Duo parsen tornado paliang ganaih balangsuang labiah dari tigo jam.
eng_text: Tornadoes uproot trees, rip boards from buildings, and fling cars up into the sky. The most violent two percent of tornadoes last more than three hours.

text: Badai monster ko mampunyoi kakancangan angin hinggo 480 km/jam (133 m/s; 300 mph).
eng_text: These monster storms have winds up to 480 km/h (133 m/s; 300 mph).

text: Manusia alah mambuek jo manggunoan lensa untuak panggadang salamo baribu-ribu taun.
eng_text: Humans have been making and using lenses for magnification for thousands and thousands of years.

text: Namun, teleskop sajatinyo patamo sakali dibuek di Eropa pado akia abaik ka-16.
eng_text: However, the first true telescopes were made in Europe in the late 16th century.

text: Teleskop ko manggunoan gabuangan duo lensa untuak mambuek objek jauah tampak labiah dakek jo labiah gadang.
eng_text: These telescopes used a combination of two lenses to make distant objects appear both nearer and larger.

text: Sipaik sarakah jo nio manang surang ka taruih basamo kito, alah biaso ado dalam karajo samo baso kauntuangan jumlah urang nan labiah banyak akan ka taruih labiah banyak di dalam jangko wakatu singkek katiko batindak nio manang surang
eng_text: Greed and selfishness will always be with us and it is the nature of cooperation that when the majority benefit there will always be more to gain in the short term by acting selfishly

text: Mudah-mudahan kabanyakan urang manyadari baso piliahan paliang rancak untuak jangko panjang adolah bakarajo samo jo urang lain.
eng_text: Hopefully, most people will realise that their long term best option is to work together with others.

text: Banyak urang maarokan hari katiko manusia dapek malakuan pajalanan ka bintang lain sarato manjalajahi dunia lain, babarapo urang batanyo-tanyo apo nan ado di lua tu, babarapo picayo baso alien atau kahidupan lain mungkin iduik di planet lain.
eng_text: Many people dream of the day when humans can travel to another star and explore other worlds, some people wonder what's out there some belive that aliens or other life may live on another plant.

text: Tapi, jikok iko tajadi, mungkin indak ka tajadi untuak wakatu nan lamo. Bintang-bintang sangaik tapanca-panca sahinggo ado jarak triliunan mil di antaro bintang-bintang nan "badakekan".
eng_text: But, if this ever does happen probably won't happen for a very long time. The stars are so spread out that there are trillions of miles between stars that are "neighbors".

text: Mungkinkah suatu hari kamudian, cicit dunsanak tagak di ateh dunia asiang batanyo-tanyo tantang nenek moyang kunonyo?
eng_text: Maybe one day, your great grandchildren will be standing atop an alien world wondering about their ancient ancestors?

text: Binatang tabuek dari banyak sel. Inyo mamakan sasuatu sudah tu maancuan makanan tu di dalam badannyo. Sabagian gadang binatang tu dapek manggarik.
eng_text: Animals are made of many cells. They eat things and digest them inside. Most animals can move.

text: Hanyo binatang nan mampunyoi utak (walaupun baitu indak kasado binatang mampunyoi utak; ubua-ubua, sabagai contohnyo, indak mampunyoi utak).
eng_text: Only animals have brains (though not even all animals do; jellyfish, for example, do not have brains).

text: Binatang ditamukan di saluruh bumi. Inyo manggali tanah, baranang di lauik, jo tabang dilangik.
eng_text: Animals are found all over the earth. They dig in the ground, swim in the oceans, and fly in the sky.

text: Sel adolah bagian struktur jo fungsi nan paliang ketek dari sagalo macam makhluk (bando) iduik.
eng_text: A cell is the smallest structural and functional unit of a living (things) organism.

text: Sel barasa dari kato bahaso Latin nan bararti biliak nan ketek.
eng_text: Cell comes from the Latin word cella which means small room.

text: Jikok dunsanak maliek makhluk iduik di bawah mikroskop, dunsanak bisa mancaliak baso inyo tabuek dari kotak-kotak atau bola-bola ketek.
eng_text: If you look at living things under a microscope, you will see that they are made of small squares or balls.

text: Robert Hooke, ahli biologi dari Inggirih, maliek kotak-kotak ketek dalam gabuih tutuik boto manggunoan mikroskop.
eng_text: Robert Hooke, a biologist from England, saw small squares in cork with a microscope.

text: Kotak-kotak tu nampak takah biliak. Hooke adolah urang patamo nan mamparatian sel-sel mati
eng_text: They looked like rooms. He was the first person to observe dead cells

text: Unsua jo sanyao dapek bapindah dari ciek kaadaan ka kaadaan lainnyo atau indak barubah.
eng_text: Elements and compounds can move from one state to another and not change.

text: Nitrogen nan babantuak gas masih samo sipaiknyo jo nitrogen caia. Kaadaan caia ko labiah rapek tatapi molekulnyo masih tatap samo.
eng_text: Nitrogen as a gas still has the same properties as liquid nitrogen. The liquid state is denser but the molecules are still the same.

text: Aia adolah contoh lainnyo. Sanyao ko tabantuak dari duo atom hidrogen jo ciek atom oksigen.
eng_text: Water is another example. The compound water is made up of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.

text: Inyo punyo susunan molakual nan samo, baiak itu barado dalam kaadaan uok, caia, ataupun padek.
eng_text: It has the same molecular structure whether it is a gas, liquid, or solid.

text: Walaupun bantuak nan nampak dek awak nyo barubah, bantuak kimianyo tatap sajo samo.
eng_text: Although its physical state may change, its chemical state remains the same.

text: Wakatu adolah sasuatu nan salalu ado di sakitar awak, sarato mamangaruahi apo-apo nan awak karajoan, sakalipun mode tu tapi masih payah untuak dimangarati.
eng_text: Time is something that is all around us, and affects everything we do, yet is difficult to understand.

text: Wakatu alah dipalajari dek ahli agamo, ahli ilimu pangatauan, sarato urang cadiak pandai salamo ribuan taun.
eng_text: Time has been studied by religious, philosophical, and scientific scholars for thousands of years.

text: Awak mangalami wakatu sabagai urutan kajadian nan balalu dari maso muko malalui maso kini ka maso lampau.
eng_text: We experience time as a series of events passing from the future through the present to the past.

text: Wakatu adolah baa awak mambandiangan lamonyo (panjangnyo) sabuah kajadian.
eng_text: Time is also how we compare the duration (length) of events.

text: Dunsanak dapek manandoi balalunyo wakatu jo caro mangamaiki pangulangan kajadian baputa ulang. Kajadian baputa ulang adolah sasuatu nan tajadi baulang-ulang sacaro taratur.
eng_text: You can mark the passing of time yourself by observing the repetition of a cyclical event. A cyclical event is something that happens again and again regularly.

text: Komputer kini ko digunoan untuak mamanipulasi gambar jo video.
eng_text: Computers today are used to manipulate pictures and videos.

text: Animasi nan canggih dapek dibuek di komputer, sarato animasi mode iko samakin banyak digunoan di tipi jo pilem.
eng_text: Sophisticated animations can be constructed on computers, and this kind of animation is increasingly being used in television and films.

text: Musik acok direkam manggunoan komputer nan canggih untuak mangolah sarato manggabuangan suaro.
eng_text: Music is often recorded using sophisticated computers to process and mix sounds together.

text: Dalam wakatu nan lamo salamo abaik sambilan baleh jo duo puluah, dipicayo baso pauni patamo Selandia Baru adolah urang Maori, nan baburu buruang gadang banamo moa.
eng_text: For a long time during the nineteenth and twentieth centuries, it was believed the first inhabitants of New Zealand were the Maori people, who hunted giant birds called moas.

text: Teori tu kamudian mambangun pamikiran baso urang Maori pindah dari Polinesia dalam sabuah Rombongan Gadang sarato marabuik Selandia Baru dari urang Moriori, kamudian mambantuak masyarakaik nan bacocok tanam.
eng_text: The theory then established the idea that the Maori people migrated from Polynesia in a Great Fleet and took New Zealand from the Moriori, establishing an agricultural society.

text: Akan tatapi, bukti baru maagiah pandapek baso Moriori adolah sakalompok Maori daratan nan pindah dari Selandia Baru ka Kapulauan Chatham, kamudian inyo mangambangan budayo inyo surang nan khas, sarato budayo nan damai.
eng_text: However, new evidence suggests that the Moriori were a group of mainland Maori who migrated from New Zealand to the Chatham Islands, developing their own distinctive, peaceful culture.

text: Ado pulo suku lain di Pulau Chatham namonyo Maori nan pindah dari Selandia Baru.
eng_text: There was also another tribe on the Chatham islands these were Maori who migrated away from New Zealand.

text: Urang tu manyabuik dirinyo Moriori yang mano pado akianyo ado babarapo pasalisiahan ketek, urang Moriori akianyo punah
eng_text: They called themselves the Moriori there were a few skirmishes and in the end, the Moriori were wiped out

text: Urang-urang nan alah sato salamo babarapo dakade manolong awak maharagoi kakuatan jo kainginan awak sambia sacaro taruih tarang manilai kasulikan sarato kagagalan.
eng_text: Individuals who had been involved for several decades helped us appreciate our strengths and passions while candidly assessing difficulties and even failures.

text: Katiko mandanga urang bacarito tantang diri, kaluarga, sarato organisasinyo, awak mandapekan wawasan nan baharago ka maso lalu sarto babarapo sipaik urang nan bapangaruah sacaro baiak atau buruak dalam sabuah organisasi.
eng_text: While listening to individuals share their individual, family, and organizational stories, we gained valuable insight into the past and some of the personalities who influenced for good or ill the culture of the organization.

text: Katiko mamahami carito urang bukan baarti mamahami pulo budayonyo, paliang indak itu mambantu urang paham di ma tampeknyo dalam sajarah kalompok.
eng_text: While understanding one’s history does not assume understanding of culture, it does at least help people gain a sense of where they fall within the history of the organization.

text: Katiko manilai kabarasilan sarato manyadari kagagalan, awak sarato sado urang nan sato manamuan labiah dalam nilai, misi, sarato tanago pandorong dalam organisasi.
eng_text: While assessing the successes and becoming aware of failures, individuals and the whole of the participating persons discover more deeply the values, mission, and driving forces of the organization.

text: Pado kajadian ko, maingek kambali kabiasoan pangusao sabalunnyo sarato kabarasilan nan alah tabukti dapek manolong urang-urang untuak tabukak taadok parubahan baru sarato arah baru untuak gareja satampek.
eng_text: In this instance, recalling previous instances of entrepreneurial behavior and resulting successes helped people to be open to new changes and new direction for the local church.

text: Carito-carito kabarasilan saroman tu mangurangan raso takuik taadok parubahan, sakaligus mambuek parubahan nan condong ka arah nan elok di maso nan ka datang.
eng_text: Such success stories lessened the fears of change, while creating positive inclinations toward change in the future.

text: Pola pemikiran konvergen adalah teknik pemecahan masalah yang menyatukan perbedaan ide atau bidang untuk menemukan solusi
eng_text: Convergent thinking patterns are problem solving techniques that unite different ideas or fields to find a solution.

text: Pokus dari pola pikia iko adolah kakancangan, logika, jo akurasi, salain itu identipikasi dari pakta, panerapan ulang dari teknik nan alah ado, mangumpuan inpormasi.
eng_text: The focus of this mindset is speed, logic and accuracy, also identification of facts, reapplying existing techniques, gathering information.

text: Paktor paliang paralu dari pola pikia iko adolah: hanyo ado ciek jawaban batua. Awak hanyo bapikia duo jawaban, batua atau salah.
eng_text: The most important factor of this mindset is: there is only one correct answer. You only think of two answers, namely right or wrong.

text: Tipe bapikia mode iko tahubuang jo ilimu atau caro standar tatantu.
eng_text: This type of thinking is associated with certain science or standard procedures.

text: Orang-orang dengan tipe pemikiran ini memiliki pemikiran logis, mampu untuk mengingat pola, memecahkan masalah dan menyelesaikan ujian saintifik
eng_text: People with this type of thinking have logical thinking, are able to memorize patterns, solve problems and work on scientific tests.

text: Manusia sajauah ko adolah tipe nan paliang santiang mambaco pikiran nan lain.
eng_text: Humans are by far the most talented species in reading the minds of others.

text: Aratinyo awak bisa barasil mangiro-ngiro apo nan urang lain rasoan, mukasuik, picayo, katahui sarato apo nan urang nio.
eng_text: That means we are able to successfully predict what other humans perceive, intend, believe, know or desire.

text: Di antaro kamampuan tu, mangarati jo niaik urang lain tu pantiang bana. Hal tu mambuek awak bisa manyalasaian kamungkinan kaindakpastian garakan pisik.
eng_text: Among these abilities, understanding the intention of others is crucial. It allows us to resolve possible ambiguities of physical actions.

text: Sabagai contoh, jikok dunsanak mancaliak urang mamacahan sabuah kaco oto, bakamungkinan dunsanak mangiro kalau urang tu nio mancilok oto urang lain.
eng_text: For example, if you were to see someone breaking a car window, you would probably assume he was trying to steal a stranger’s car.

text: Urang tu paralu dinilai sacaro babeda jikok kironyo inyo kailangan kunci otonyo, sarato nan sabananyo oto tu oto inyo sahinggo inyo bausao masuak ka dalam.
eng_text: He would need to be judged differently if he had lost his car keys and it was his own car that he was trying to break into.

text: MRI adolah badasar ka tando-tando pisik nan dinamoan Garetek Magnetik Nuklir (NMR), nan ditamuan pado taun 1930-an dek Felix Bloch (karajo di Universitas Stanford) jo Edward Purcell (dari Universitas Harvard).
eng_text: MRI is based on a physics phenomenon called nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR), which was discovered in the 1930s by Felix Bloch (working at Stanford University) and Edward Purcell (from Harvard University).

text: Dalam resonansi ko, medan magnetik jo galombang radio manyababan atom mangaluaan sinyal radio nan ketek.
eng_text: In this resonance, magnetic field and radio waves cause atoms to give off tiny radio signals.

text: Pado taun 1970, Raymond Damadian, saurang dotor marangkap panaliti, manamuan dasar untuak panggunoan pancitraan resonansi magnetik sabagai alaik untuak mamareso kasehatan.
eng_text: In the year 1970, Raymond Damadian, a medical doctor and research scientist, discovered the basis for using magnetic resonance imaging as a tool for medical diagnosis.

text: Ampek taun sasudah hak buwek tu diagiah, nan mano marupokan hak buek patamo di bidang MRI.
eng_text: Four years later a patent was granted, which was the world's first patent issued in the field of MRI.

text: Pado taun 1977, Dr. Damadian mayalasaian pamindai MRI patamo‘’sapatagak badan’’, nan mano akianyo inyo sabuik “si Gigiah”.
eng_text: In 1977, Dr. Damadian completed the construction of the first “whole-body” MRI scanner, which he called the ”Indomitable”.

text: Komunikasi nan indak manyambuang mambuek ado waktu untuak maranuang sarato basikap baliak ka urang lain.
eng_text: Asynchronous communication encourages time for reflection and reaction to others.

eng_text: It allows students the ability to work at their own pace and control the pace of instructional information.

eng_text: The use of the Internet and the World Wide Web allows learners to have access to information at all times.

eng_text: Students can also submit questions to instructors at any time of day and expect reasonably quick responses, rather than waiting until the next face-to-face meeting.

text: Pandangan siap jaman moderen taadok baraja maagiah kabebasan nan mutlak. Indak ado ciek pun caro nan rancak untuak baraja.
eng_text: The postmodern approach to learning offers the freedom from absolutes. There is no one good way to learn.

eng_text: In fact, there is not one good thing to learn.Learning takes place in the experience between the learner and the knowledge presented.

eng_text: Our current experience with all the do-it-yourself and information presenting, learning-based television shows illustrates this point.

text: Banyak bana dari awak ko nan manonton acara tipi nan maagiah tau awak caro karajo atau pangalaman nan awak indak ka pernah sato atau mangalami pangatauan tu.
eng_text: So many of us find ourselves watching a television show that informs us of a process or experience in which we will never participate or apply that knowledge.

eng_text: We will never overhaul a car, build a fountain in our backyard, travel to Peru to examine ancient ruins, or remodel our neighbour's house.

eng_text: Thanks to undersea fiber optic cable links to Europe and broadband satellite, Greenland is well connected with 93% of the population having internet access.

text: Sarupo disabuikan di ateh, walaupun kato “Eskimo” tatap ditarimo di Amerika Serikat, hal itu dipandang marandahan dek kebanyakan urang-urang Arktik non-AS, khususnyo di Kanada.
eng_text: As mentioned above, though the word "Eskimo" remains acceptable in the United States, it is considered pejorative by many non-U.S. Arctic peoples, especially in Canada.

text: Samantaro dunsanak mungkin mandanga kato nan dipakai Urang Asli Greenland, pamakaiannyo saharusnyo dihindari dek urang asiang.
eng_text: While you may hear the word used by Greenlandic Natives, its use should be avoided by foreigners.

text: Panduduak asli Greenland manyabuik dirinyo urang Inuit di Kanada dan Kalaalleg (jamak Kalaallit), urang Greenland, di Greenland.
eng_text: The native inhabitants of Greenland call themselves Inuit in Canada and Kalaalleq (plural Kalaallit), a Greenlander, in Greenland.

eng_text: Crime, and ill-will toward foreigners in general, is virtually unknown in Greenland. Even in the towns, there are no "rough areas."

eng_text: The very long days in the summer can lead to problems getting sufficient sleep and associated health issues.
