text: Walaupun iko marupokan kagiatan nan cukuik umum, sabananyo iko dilarang dek Disney: karicih indak bisa dipindahtanganan.
eng_text: While this is a very common activity, it is prohibited by Disney: the tickets are non-transferable.

text: Satiok pakemahan di bawah tapian di Grand Canyon paralu izin masuak padalaman.
eng_text: Any camping below the rim in Grand Canyon requires a backcountry permit.

text: Izinnyo dibatehan untuak malinduangi ngarai, dan tasadio di hari partamo tiok bulan, ampek bulan sabalun bulan partamo.
eng_text: Permits are limited to protect the canyon, and become available on the 1st day of the month, four months prior to the start month.

text: Sahinggo, izin masuak padalaman untuak mulai tanggal barapo pun di bulan Mai tasadio pado tanggal 1 Januari.
eng_text: Thus, a backcountry permit for any start date in May becomes available on 1 Jan.

text: Bagian untuak area nan paliang populer, mode Bright Angel Campground nan sabalah Phantom Ranch, umumnyo taisi panuah jo pamintaan nan ditarimo di tanggal partamo area tu dibukak untuak reservasi.
eng_text: Space for the most popular areas, such as the Bright Angel Campground adjacent to Phantom Ranch, generally fill up by the requests received on first date they are opened to reservations.

text: Ado sajumlah izin terbatas nan disadiokan untuak permintaan masuak badasarkan sia nan tibo dulu, dilayani dulu.
eng_text: There are a limited number permits reserved for walk-in requests available on a first come, first served basis.

text: Masuak ka Afrika Salatan jo oto adolah caro nan mantap untuak manliek kasaluruahan wilayah nan rancak tu sarupo juo untuak pai ka tampek nan indak dikunjuangi turih biaso.
eng_text: Entering Southern Africa by car is an amazing way to see all the region's beauty as well as to get to places off the normal tourist routes.

text: Hal ko bisa dikarajoan jo oto biaso jo parancanaan nan bahati-hati tapi oto 4x4 sangaik disaranan jo banyak tampek nan hanyo bisa didatangi jo oto 4x4 nan baroda tinggi.
eng_text: This can be done in a normal car with careful planning but a 4x4 is highly advised and many locations are only accessible with a high wheel base 4x4.

text: Paralu diingek katiko mambuek rancana baso walaupun Afrika Salatan cukuik aman tapi negara-negara nan badakekan alun tantu aman.
eng_text: Keep in mind while planning that although Southern Africa is stable not all neighboring countries are.

text: Syaraik untuak visa sarato biayanyo baragam dari ciek negara ka negara lain sarato tagantuang dari negara ma dunsanak datang.
eng_text: Visa requirements and costs vary from nation to nation and are affected by the country you come from.

text: Masiang-masiang negara punyo hukum nan khas nan mawajiban barang-barang darurat apo se nan paralu ado taruih di dalam oto.
eng_text: Each country also has unique laws requiring what emergency items need to be in the car.

text: Victoria Falls adolah sabuah kota di bagian baraik Zimbabwe, malintehi bateh dari Livingstone, Zambia, sarato jo dakek Botswana.
eng_text: Victoria Falls is a town in the western portion of Zimbabwe, across the border from Livingstone, Zambia, and near Botswana.

text: Kota tu talatak di subalah aia tajun bana, itu manjadi tontonan utamo di sinan, tapi tampek tujuan turih tanamo ko manawaran baiak ka pancari patualangan ataupun ka turih kasempatan untuak tingga labiah lamo.
eng_text: The town lies immediately next to the falls, and they are the major attraction, but this popular tourist destination offers both adventure seekers and sightseers plenty of opportunities for a longer stay.

text: Pado musim paujan (November sampai Maret), jumlah banyaknyo aia akan labiah tinggi sarato aia tajun akan samakin bagamuruah.
eng_text: In the rainy season (November to March), the water volume will be higher and the Falls will be more dramatic.

text: Dunsanak dijamin akan basah jikok manyubarangi jambatan atau bajalan di sapanjang jalan nan bakelok-kelok di dakek aia tajun.
eng_text: You are guaranteed to get wet if you cross the bridge or walk along the trails winding near the Falls.

text: Samantaro itu, karano jumlah aia nan sangaik banyak sahinggo manyababan pamandangan dunsanak nan sabananyo dari aia tajun tu akan manjadi indak jaleh—dek karano aia se sadonyo!
eng_text: On the other hand, it is precisely because the volume of water is so high that your viewing of the actual Falls will be obscured—by all the water!

text: Pandam Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 mungkin adolah pandam nan paliang tanamo di Lambah, tampek Howard Carter pado taun 1922 manamuan pandam rajo mudo nan ampia langkok.
eng_text: Tomb of Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 may be the most famous of the tombs in the Valley, the scene of Howard Carter's 1922 discovery of the almost intact royal burial of the young king.

text: Dibandiangan jo kabanyakan pandam karajoan, baapun, pandam Tutankhamun ko ampia indak patuik untuak dikunjuangi, sabab jauah labiah ketek sarato indak banyak hiasan.
eng_text: Compared to most of the other royal tombs, however, the tomb of Tutankhamun is barely worth visiting, being much smaller and with limited decoration.

text: Sia se nan nio mancaliak bukti dari karusakan mumi nan tajadi salamo upayo untuak magaluaan mumi dari peti mati pasti akan baketek ati sabab hanyo kapalo jo baun nan nampak.
eng_text: Anyone interested in seeing evidence of the damage to the mummy done during attempts to remove it from the coffin will be disappointed as only the head and shoulders are visible.

text: Kakayoan pandam nan mewah tu indak ado di dalamnyo lai tapi alah dipindahan ka Museum Mesir di Kairo.
eng_text: The fabulous riches of the tomb are no longer in it, but have been removed to the Egyptian Museum in Cairo.

text: Pangunjuang nan punyo wakatu tabateh mungkin sarancaknyo maabihan wakatunyo di tampek lain.
eng_text: Visitors with limited time would be best to spend their time elsewhere.

text: Phonm Krom, talatak 12 km di subalah baraik daya Siem Reap. Kuia nan barado di puncak bukik ko dibangun pado akia abaik ka-9, pado maso pamarintahan Rajo Yasovarman.
eng_text: Phnom Krom, 12 km southwest of Siem Reap. This hilltop temple was built at the end of the 9th century, during the reign of King Yasovarman.

text: Kaadaan kuia nan suram sarato jo pamandangan danau Tonle Sap mambuek pandakian ka bukik manjadi labiah baharago.
eng_text: The gloomy atmosphere of the temple and the view over the Tonle Sap lake make the climb to the hill worthwhile.

text: Kunjuangan ka tampek paninggalan maso dulu ko dapek dikombinasikan jo panggunoan kapa bot ka danau.
eng_text: A visit to the site can be conveniently combined with a boat trip to the lake.

text: Angkor Pass diparaluan untuak masuak ka kuia jadi jan lupo mambao paspor dunsanak katiko pai ka Tonle Sap.
eng_text: The Angkor Pass is needed to enter the temple so do not forget to bring your passport along when heading to Tonle Sap.

text: Yerusalem adolah ibu kota sarato kota paliang gadang di Israel, walaupun baitu sabagian gadang negara lain jo PBB indak mangakuinyo sabagai ibu kota Israel.
eng_text: Jerusalem is the capital and largest city of Israel, though most other countries and the United Nations do not recognize it as Israel's capital.

text: Kota kuno di pabukikan yudea mampunyoi sajarah nan sangaik mamikek salamo ribuan taun.
eng_text: The ancient city in the Judean Hills has a fascinating history spanning thousands of years.

text: Kota ko dianggap suci dek tigo agamo nan picayo baso tuhan tu ciek – Yaudi, Kiristen jo Islam, nan bapungsi sabagai pusek kayakinan, agamo, jo budayo.
eng_text: The city is holy to the three monotheistic religions - Judaism, Christianity and Islam, and serves as a spiritual, religious, and cultural center.

text: Karano kota ko pantiang dek agamo, tarutamo dek banyak situs paninggalan di salingka Old City, Yerusalem manjadi salah satu tujuan wisata utamo di Israel.
eng_text: Due to the religious significance of the city, and in particular the many sites of the Old City area, Jerusalem is one of the main tourist destinations in Israel.

text: Yerusalem punyo banyak situs basajarah, arkeologi, sarato budayo, basamoan pulo jo tampek-tampek balanjo, tampek minum, sarato rumah makan nan sangaik rami.
eng_text: Jerusalem has many historic, archeological and cultural sites, along with vibrant and crowded shopping centers, cafés, and restaurants.

text: Ekuador mawajibkan urang-urang Kuba manarimo surek undangan sabalun masuak ka Ekuador malalui bandara internasional atau nan masuak malalui pabatehan.
eng_text: Ecuador requires that Cuban citizens receive an invitation letter prior to entering Ecuador through international airports or frontier admission points.

text: Surek ko paralu disahan dulu dek Kamenterian Lua Nagari Ekuador, sarato mamanuahi syaraik tatantu.
eng_text: This letter must be legalized by the Ecuadorian Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and comply with certain requirements.

text: Syaraik-syaraik ko dibuek supayo aliran papindahan di antaro kaduo negara ko labiah taratur.
eng_text: These requirements are designed to provide an organized migratory flow between both countries.

text: Warga negara Kuba nan marupoan pamacik karatu ijau AS paralu datang ka Konsulat Ekuador untuak mandapek pangacualian dari syaraik ko.
eng_text: Cuban citizens who are US green card holders should visit an Ecuadorian Consulate to obtain an exemption to this requirement.

text: Surek izin pajalanan dunsanak harus balaku saindaknyo 6 bulan sabalun hari kabarangkekan. Karicih pulang/pai diparaluan untuak mancaliak bara lamo dunsanak tingga.
eng_text: Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months beyond your travel dates. A round/onward trip ticket is needed to prove the length of your stay.

text: Ongkosnyo labiah murah jikok pai basamo samo, sarancaknyo jikok dunsanak nio pai surang atau jo surang kawan, cubo cari urang lain untuak diajak dan bantuak ciek kalompok nan tadiri dari ampek sampai anam urang.
eng_text: Tours are cheaper for larger groups, so if you're by yourself or with just one friend, try to meet other people and form a group of four to six for a better per-person rate.

text: Sabananyo, iko indak harus manjadi paratian dunsanak, karano acok wisatawan pai malala jo oto.
eng_text: However, this shouldn't really be off your concern, because often tourists are shuffled around to fill the cars.

text: Subananya banyak caro untuak manipu urang lain supayo mambayia labiah banyak.
eng_text: It seems actually to be more a way of tricking people into believing they have to pay more.

text: Di ujuang utara Machu Picchu mambumbuang tinggi gunuang curam, acok bana dijadian tampek latar balakang bapoto di runtuahan.
eng_text: Towering above the north end of Machu Picchu is this steep mountain, often the backdrop to many photos of the ruins.

text: Bantuaknyo agak manakuikan dari bawah, jo iko adolah pandakian nan sarik jo curam, tapi urang nan siaik bisa sampai dalam 45 minik.
eng_text: It looks a bit daunting from below, and it is a steep and difficult ascent, but most reasonably fit persons should be able to make it in about 45 minutes.

text: Janjang batu dilatakan dihampia sapanjang jalan, dan dibagian tampek nan labiah curam disadioaan kawek untuak dipacik.
eng_text: Stone steps are laid along most of the path, and in the steeper sections steel cables provide a supporting handrail.

text: Karano itu, basadiolah untuak kahabihan angok, dan elok elok lah ditampek nan labiah curam, apolai katiko basah, karano itu bisa jadi sangaik babahayo.
eng_text: That said, expect to be out of breath, and take care in the steeper portions, especially when wet, as it can become dangerous quickly.

text: Ado sabuah guo ketek di dakek puncak tu nan harus dilampui, cukuik randah dan agak sampik.
eng_text: There's a tiny cave near the top that must be passed through, it is quite low and a rather tight squeeze.

text: Mancaliak tampek jo binatang lia Galapagos sarancaknyo mamakai biduak, takah nan dilakuan dek Charles Darwin di taun 1835.
eng_text: Seeing the sites and wildlife of the Galapagos is best done by boat, just as Charles Darwin did it in 1835.

text: Labiah dari 60 kapa pasiar malalui lauiktan di Galapagos – mulai dari kapa nan mamuek 8 sampai 100 urang.
eng_text: Over 60 cruise ships ply the Galapagos waters - ranging in size from 8 to 100 passengers.

text: Kabanyakan urang mamasan tampek duduak jauah-jauah ari (karno biduak tu biasonyo panuah salamo musim rami).
eng_text: Most people book their place well in advance (as the boats are usually full during the high season).

text: Tantuan bana kalau parantaro pajalanan ka Galapagos nan dunsanak pasan tu adolah urang nan bana-bana tau jo babagai macam kapa.
eng_text: Be sure the agent through whom you book is a Galapagos specialist with a good knowledge of a wide variety of ships.

text: Iko untuak mamastian salero tatantu dunsanak dan/atau masalah tatantu sainggo dapek kapa nan tapek untuak panumpang.
eng_text: This will ensure that your particular interests and/or constraints are matched with the ship most suitable to them.

text: Sabalun Sapanyol tibo pado abaik ka 16, Cili utara barado di bawah kakuasaan Inka samantaro tu panduduak asli Araucanians (Mapuche) mauni bagian Cili tangah jo salatan.
eng_text: Before the Spanish arrived in the 16th century, northern Chile was under Inca rule while the indigenous Araucanians (Mapuche) inhabited central and southern Chile.

text: Mapuche marupoan salah satu kalompok urang asli Amerika nan indak tapangaruah, nan indak sapanuahnyo tapangaruah dek pamarintahan nan babahaso Sapanyol sampai sasudah kamardekaan Cili.
eng_text: The Mapuche were also one of the last independent American indigenous groups, that were not fully absorbed into Spanish-speaking rule until after Chile's independence.

text: Walau pun Cili alah mangecekan kamardekaannyo pado taun 1810 (Napelon nan maninggaan Sapanyol ditangah parang dan indak maagiahan pamarintahan pusek salamo babarapo taun) kamanangan nan manantuan ateh Sapanyol indak tacapai sampai taun 1818.
eng_text: Although Chile declared independence in 1810 (amid the Napoleonic wars that left Spain without a functioning central government for a couple of years), decisive victory over the Spanish was not achieved until 1818.

text: Republik Dominika (bahaso Spanyol: Republica Domincana) adolah negara Karibia nan talatak di arah timur bagian tangah pulau Hispaniola, nan babagi jo Haiti.
eng_text: The Dominican Republic (Spanish: República Dominicana) is a Caribbean country that occupies the eastern half of the island of Hispaniola, which it shares with Haiti

text: Salain pantai bapasia putiah jo pagunuangan, di nagara ko ado kota Eropa nan tatuo di Amerika, kini ko tamasuak bagian dari Santo Dominggo.
eng_text: Besides white sand beaches and mountain landscapes, the country is home to the oldest European city in the Americas, now part of Santo Domingo.

text: Nan patamo kali tingga di pulau ko adolah urang Tainos jo urang Caribes. Urang Caribes lah ado samanjak 10,000 SM dan inyo manggunoan bahaso Arawakan.
eng_text: The island was first inhabited by the Taínos and Caribes. The Caribes were an Arawakan-speaking people who had arrived around 10,000 BCE.

text: Dalam babarapo tahun samanjak kadatangan panjalajah Eropa, populasi urang Tainos sacaro signipikan bakurang dek panjajahan Spanyol.
eng_text: Within a few short years following the arrival of European explorers, the population of Tainos had significantly been reduced by the Spanish conquerors

text: Marujuak dari Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) antaro 1492 sampai 1498 urang Spanyol mambunuah kurang labiah 100,000 urang Tainos.
eng_text: Based on Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) between 1492 and 1498 the Spanish conquerors killed around 100,000 Taínos.

text: Jardín de la Unión. Ruangan ko dibuek sabagai tampek tabukak untuak biaro pado abaik ka 17, di mano Templo de San Diego adolah satu-satunyo bangunan nan masih ado.
eng_text: Jardín de la Unión. This space was built as the atrium for a 17th-century convent, of which the Templo de San Diego is the sole surviving building.

text: Kini digunoan sabagai pusek medan nan bapaneh, dan acok tajadi hal-hal di sinan, siang jo malam.
eng_text: It now functions as the central plaza, and always has a lot of things going on, day and night.

text: Ado babarapo lapau nasi di sakaliliang taman, di sanjo jo malam ari ado konser perai nan acok diadoan di dangau.
eng_text: There are a number of restaurants surrounding the garden, and in the afternoons and evening there free concerts are often given from the central gazebo.

text: Callejon del Beso (Gang Cium). Duo anjuang nan dipisahan sajarak 69 sentimeter adolah rumah dari lagenda cinta lamo.
eng_text: Callejon del Beso (Alley of the Kiss). Two balconies separated by only 69 centimeters is home of an old love legend.

text: Babarapo anak akan nio mancaritoan caritonyo ka dunsanak katiko dibayia babarapo sen.
eng_text: For a few pennies some children will tell you the story.

text: Pulau Bowen tadanga rancak untuak pai malala sahari atau saminggu karano manyadioan rakik, tampek malala di rimbo, tampek babalanjo, lapau nasi dan masih banyak nan lainnyo.
eng_text: Bowen Island is a popular day trip or weekend excursion offering kayaking, hiking, shops, restaurants, and more.

text: Kalompok asli ko barado di Howe Sound nan talatak indak jauah dari Vancouver, dan mudah untuak dijangkau malalui kapa bot nan alah tajadwal nan barangkek dari pulau Granville di pusek kota Vancouver.
eng_text: This authentic community is located in Howe Sound just off Vancouver, and is easily accessed via scheduled water taxis departing Granville Island in downtown Vancouver.

text: Untuak urang-urang nan manyukoi kagiatan di lua ruangan, bajalan-jalan di lorong Sea to Sky sangaik ancak untuak di cubo.
eng_text: For those who enjoy outdoor activities, a trek up the Sea to Sky corridor is essential.

text: Whistler (1,5 jam pajalanan dari Vancouver) biayanyo sangaik maha tapi urang nio pai karano patandingan Olimpiade musim Dingin 2010.
eng_text: Whistler (1.5 hour drive from Vancouver) is expensive but well-known because of the 2010 Winter Olympics.

text: Di musim dingin, cubolah untuak marasoan basiluncua salju di Amerika Utara, dan di musim paneh cuboan untuak basapeda di gunuang nan udaronyo masih tajago.
eng_text: In the winter, enjoy some of the best skiing in North America, and in the summer try some authentic mountain biking.

text: Biasonyo surek izin harus dipasan talabiah daulu. Dunsanak mungkin mambutuhannyo kalau nio bamalam di Sirena.
eng_text: Permits must be reserved in advance. You must have a permit to stay overnight at Sirena.

text: Sirena adolah satu-satunyo tampek nan manyadioan tampek panginapan dan makanan angek salain bakaemah. La Leona, San Pedrillo, dan Los Patos hanyo manyadioan bakemah dan indak manyadioan palayanan makanan.
eng_text: Sirena is the only ranger station that offers dormitory lodging and hot meals in addition to camping. La Leona, San Pedrillo, and Los Patos offer only camping with no food service.

text: Dimungkinan untuak mandapekan surek izin langsuang dari panjago taman di Puerto Jiménez, tatapi urang-urang tu indak manarimo kartu kredit
eng_text: It is possible to secure park permits directly from the Ranger Station in Puerto Jiménez, but they do not accept credit cards

text: Palayanan Taman (MINAE) indak mangaluaan izin labiah dari sabulan untuak kadatangan nan akan tibo.
eng_text: The Park Service (MINAE) does not issue park permits more than one month in advance of anticipated arrival.

text: CafeNet El Sol manyadioan pamasanan layanan jauah jauah ari nan diharagoi US$30, atau $10 untuak sakali pamasanan; untuak panjalehan labiah lanjuik caliak di pancarian halaman Corcovado.
eng_text: CafeNet El Sol offers a reservation service for a fee of US$30, or $10 for one-day passes; details on their Corcovado page.

text: Kapulauan Cook adolah nagara kapulauan nan bagabuang sacaro indak taikek jo Selandia Baru, tampeknyo barado di Polinesia, ditangah samudera Pasifik Salatan.
eng_text: The Cook Islands are an island country in free association with New Zealand, located in Polynesia, in the middle of the South Pacific Ocean.

text: Iko adolah nagara kapulauan nan mampunyoi 15 pulau nan taseba di 2,2 juta km2 di samudera.
eng_text: It is an archipelago with 15 islands spread out over 2.2 million km2 of ocean.

text: Dek wakatu nyo nan samo jo Hawaii, pulau pulau tu acok juo disabuik "Hawaii nan di bawah".
eng_text: With the same time zone as Hawaii, the islands are sometimes thought of as "Hawaii down under".

text: Karano keteknyo, itu maingekan babarapo pangunjuang Hawaii nan lah lamo baaso indak ado tampek panginapan gadang untuak pangunjuang ataupun pambangunan lainnyo.
eng_text: Though smaller, it reminds some elderly visitors of Hawaii before statehood without all the large tourist hotels and other development.

text: Kapulauan Cook indak mampunyoi kota tatapi tadapek 15 pulau nan babeda. Salah satunyo adolah pulau Rarotonga jo Aitutaki.
eng_text: The Cook Islands do not have any cities but are composed of 15 different islands. The main ones are Rarotonga and Aitutaki.

text: Di nagara maju kini ko, manyadioan tampek lalok jo makan pagi mewah alah manjadi samacam seni.
eng_text: In developed countries today, providing deluxe bed and breakfasts has been raised to a sort of art-form.

text: Di ujuang nan paliang ateh, B&Bs acok bana basaiang pado duo buah hal: tampek lalok dan tampek makan.
eng_text: At the top end, B&Bs obviously compete mainly on two main things: bedding and breakfast.

text: Dek karano itu, di tampek nan paliang coga tu nan paliang acok dicari urang adolah tampek lalok maha, salimuik nan dibuek tangan atau tampek lalok antik.
eng_text: Accordingly, at the finest such establishments one is apt to find the most luxurious bedding, maybe a handmade quilt or an antique bed.

text: Makan pagi bisa tamasuak makanan musiman daerah tu atau masakan spesial tuan rumah.
eng_text: Breakfast may include seasonal delights of the region or the host's speciality dish.

text: Latar balakangnyo adolah gaduang tuo nan basajarah ditambah jo barang-barang lamo, laman yang dipaliharo, dan sabuah kolam baranang.
eng_text: The setting might be an historic old building with antique furnishings, manicured grounds and a swimming pool.

text: Mamakai oto surang jo pai raun jauah-jauah punyo dayo pikek nan manyatu jo kamudahannyo.
eng_text: Getting into your own car and heading off on a long road trip has an intrinsic appeal in its simplicity.

text: Indak takah oto nan gadang, dunsanak mungkin lah tabiaso menggunoan oto surang-surang dan lah tau lo bara kakuatannyo.
eng_text: Unlike larger vehicles, you are probably already familiar with driving your car and know its limitations.

text: Managakan tenda di tanah surang atau disabuah daerah dalam ukuran barapun akan mudah mambuek paratiaan nan indak diinginan.
eng_text: Setting up a tent on private property or in a town of any size can easily attract unwanted attention.

text: Singkeknyo, mamakai oto surang-surang adolah caro nan paliang rancak untuak malakuan wisata pajalanan tapi jarang digunoan untuak pai wisata "bakemah".
eng_text: In short, using your car is a great way to take a road trip but seldom in itself a way to "camp".

text: Panginapan oto bisa dikarajoan kalau dunsanak punyo oto pan panjang, SUV, oto Sedan atau oto barang nan kursinyo bisa dirabahan.
eng_text: Car camping is possible if you have a large minivan, SUV, Sedan or Station Wagon with seats that lay down.

text: Babarapo otel punyo warihan mulai dari maso jaya dari kareta api uok jo kapa panumpang; sabalun Parang Dunia Kaduo, di abaik ka-19 atau mulo abaik ka-20.
eng_text: Some hotels have a heritage from the golden age of steam railways and ocean liners; before the Second World War, in the 19th or early 20th centuries.

text: otel-otel ko adola tampek urang kayo jo tanamo maso itu manginap, jo acok makan malam mewah jo kahidupan malam.
eng_text: These hotels were where the rich and the famous of the day would stay, and often had fine dining and nightlife.

text: Pakekeh lamo, kurangnyo fasilitas nan tabaru, sarato umua nan anggun tatantu marupokan sifaik urang banyak tu juo.
eng_text: The old fashioned fittings, the lack of the latest amenities, and a certain graceful agedness are also part of their character.

text: Maski pun biasonyo dipunyoi sacaro pribadi, urang tu takadang manampuang kapalo nagara nan bakunjuang sarato pajabaik tinggi lainnyo.
eng_text: While they are usually privately owned, they sometimes accommodate visiting heads of state and other dignitaries.

text: Saurang pajalan nan bapitih banyak mungkin mampatimbangkan panabangan kaliliang dunya, putuih jo maso manginap jo banyak hotel ko.
eng_text: A traveller with piles of money might consider a round the world flight, broken up with stays in many of these hotels.

text: Jaringan patukaran pahotelan adolah organisasi nan mahubuangkan palancong jo panduduak lokal nan ka urang tu kunjuangi.
eng_text: A hospitality exchange network is the organization that connects travelers with locals in the cities they are going to visit.

text: Bagabuang samo jaringan sarupo itu biasonyo hanyo paralu maisi pormulir online, walaupun babarapo jaringan manawari atau mawajiban veripikasi tambahan.
eng_text: Joining such a network usually just requires filling out an online form; although some networks offer or require additional verification.

text: Daftar tuan rumah nan tasadio kamudian diagiahan baiak dalam bantuak cetak dan/atau online, takadang basamo referensi jo ulasan oleh pangunjuang lain.
eng_text: A listing of available hosts is then provided either in print and/or online, sometimes with references and reviews by other travelers.

text: Couchsurfing dibadirikan pado Januari 2004 setalah programer komputer Casey Fenton manamukan panabangan murah ka Islandia indak mamiliki tampek tingga.
eng_text: Couchsurfing was founded in January 2004 after computer programmer Casey Fenton found a cheap flight to Iceland but did not have a place to stay.

text: Urang laki-laki tu mangirim surek elektronik wakatu itu kapado mahasiswa di universitas satampek jo manarimo sangaik banyak tawaran untuak akomodasi gratis.
eng_text: He emailed students at the local university and received an overwhelming number of offers for free accommodation.

text: Asrama tarutamo malayani untuak kaum mudo – tamu biso nan baumua duo puluahan, tapi Dunsanak acok juo bisa manamukan palancong nan labiah tuo di sinan.
eng_text: Hostels cater primarily to young people – a typical guest is in their twenties – but you can often find older travellers there too.

text: Kaluarga basamo anak-anak adolah pamandangan nan langka, tapi babarapo asrama maizinan kaluarga tu di kamar pribadi.
eng_text: Families with children are a rare sight, but some hostels do allow them in private rooms.

text: Kota Beijing di Cino ka manjadi kota tuan rumah Olimpiade Musim Dingin 2022, nan ka manjadikannyo kota partamo nan manjadi tuan rumah Olimpiade musim paneh jo musim dingin.
eng_text: The city of Beijing in China will be the host city of the Olympic Winter Games in 2022, which will make it the first city to have hosted both the summer and winter Olympics.

text: Beijing ka manjadi tuan rumah upacara pambukaan jo panutupan sarato acara es dalam ruangan.
eng_text: Beijing will host the opening and closing ceremonies and the indoor ice events.

text: Acara ski lainnyo ka diadoan di area ski Zhangjiakou, bakisa 220 km (140 mil) dari Beijing.
eng_text: Other skiing events will be at the Taizicheng ski area in Zhangjiakou, about 220 km (140 miles) from Beijing.

text: Sabagian gadang kuil mamiliki festival Tahunan mulai dari akhia November hinggo patangahan Mai, nan bavariasi manuruik kalender masiang-masiang kuil.
eng_text: Most of the temples do have an Annual festival starting from November end to Mid of May, which varies according to each temple's annual calendar.

text: Sabagian gadang fesitival kuil dirayokan sabagai bagian dari ulang tahun kuil atau ulang tahun dewa ketua atau acara gadang lainnyo nan takaik jo kuil.
eng_text: Most of the temple festivals is celebrated as part of temple's anniversary or presiding deity's birthday or any other major event associated with the temple.

text: Festival kuil Kerala sangaik manarik untuk diliek, sarato prosesi rutin gajah nan dihias, orkestra kuil, jo parayoan lainnyo.
eng_text: Kerala's temple festivals are very interesting to see, with regular procession of decorated elephants, temple orchestra and other festivities.

text: Pameran Dunia (biaso disabuik World Exposition atau hanyo Expo) adolah festival seni dan ilmiah internasional nan gadang.
eng_text: A World's Fair (commonly called World Exposition, or simply Expo) is large international festival of arts and sciences.

text: Nagara-nagara nan ikuik sato manampilkan patunjuakan jo pandidikan di paviliun untuak manampilan isu-isu dunia atau budayo jo sajarah nagaranyo.
eng_text: Participating countries present artistic and educational displays in national pavilions to showcase world issues or their country's culture and history.

text: Pameran Holtikultura Internasional adolah caro khusus nan manampilan pajangan bungo, kabun rayo, dan hal lain nan bakaitan jo tanaman.
eng_text: International Horticultural Expositions are specialised events which showcase floral displays, botanical gardens and anything else to do with plants.

text: Maski pun sacaro teori dapek balangsuang satiok tahun (asal barado di nagara nan babeda), dalam palaksaannyo indak.
eng_text: Although in theory they can take place annually (so long as they are in different countries), in practice they are not.

text: Acara ko biasonyo balangsuang antaro tigo jo anam bulan, dan diadoan di lokasi nan indak labiah ketek dari 50 hektar.
eng_text: These events normally last anywhere between three and six months, and are held on sites no smaller than 50 hectares.

text: Ado banyak format pilem nan bebeda nan alah digunoan salamo batahun-tahun. Pilem standar 35 mm (36 kali 24 mm nagatif) adolah nan paliang umum.
eng_text: There are many different film formats that have been used over the years. Standard 35 mm film (36 by 24 mm negative) is much the commonest.

text: Biasonyo dapek diisi ulang jo cukuik mudah jikok dunsanak kahabihan, dan maagiahan resolusi nan kiro-kiro sabandiang jo DSLR.
eng_text: It can usually be replenished fairly easily if you run out, and gives resolution roughly comparable to a current DSLR.

text: Babarapo kamera pilem bapormat sadang yang manggunokan pormat 6 kali 6 cm, labiah tapeknyo negatif 56 kali 56 mm.
eng_text: Some medium-format film cameras use a 6 by 6 cm format, more precisely a 56 by 56 mm negative.

text: Iko akan maagiah resolusi ampia 4 kali negatif 35 mm (3136 mm2 malawan 864).
eng_text: This gives resolution almost four times that of a 35 mm negative (3136 mm2 versus 864).

text: Kahidupan lia di antaro tema paliang manantang bagi tukang poto, dan paralu gabuangan kabaruntuangan, kasabaran, pangalaman jo paragaik nan rancak.
eng_text: Wildlife is among the most challenging motifs for a photographer, and needs a combination of good luck, patience, experience and good equipment.

text: Pamotoan binatang lia acok dianggap remeh, tapi bantuak pamotoan umum, ciek gambar banilai ribuan kato-kato.
eng_text: Wildlife photography is often taken for granted, but like photography in general, a picture is worth a thousand words.

text: Karajo mamoto kahidupan lia acok paralu lensa telepoto nan panjang, walau pun hal-hal sarupo arakan buruang jo binatang ketek paralu lensa lain.
eng_text: Wildlife photography often requires a long telephoto lens, though things like a flock of birds or a tiny creature need other lenses.

text: Banyak binatang eksotis payah tasuo, dan taman-taman takadang punyo paraturan tantang maambiak poto untuak tujuan mancari labo.
eng_text: Many exotic animals are hard to find, and parks sometimes have rules about taking photographs for commercial purposes.

text: Binatang lia bisa jadi antaro malu atau agresif. Lingkuangannyo mungkin dingin, angek atau kalau indak nan indak basahabat.
eng_text: Wild animals might either be shy or aggressive. The environment might be cold, hot, or otherwise hostile.

text: Dunia punyo labiah dari 5,000 bahaso nan babeda-beda, tamasuak labiah dari duo puluah jo 50 juta atau labiah panutuanyo.
eng_text: The world has over 5,000 different languages, including more than twenty with 50 million or more speakers.

text: Kato-kato nan tatulih acok labiah mudah dimangarati daripado kato-kato lisan, juo. Hal iko khususnyo kabanaran alamaik, nan acok payah disabuik sacaro mudah pahamnyo.
eng_text: Written words are often easier to understand than spoken words, also. This is especially true of addresses, which are often difficult to pronounce intelligibly.

text: Banyak kasado bangsa batua-batua fasiah babahaso Inggris, dan bahkan talabiah dalam pangatahuan tabateh nan dapek dunsanak sangko - apolai di antaro urang-urang nan labiah mudo.
eng_text: Many entire nations are completely fluent in English, and in even more you can expect a limited knowledge - especially among younger people.

text: Bayanganlah, jikok dunsanak namuah, urang Mancunia, urang Boston, urang Jamaika dan urang Sydney duduak mangaliliangi meja sambia makan malam di rumah makan di Toronto.
eng_text: Imagine, if you will, a Mancunian, Bostonian, Jamaican and Sydneysider sitting around a table having dinner at a restaurant in Toronto.

text: Urang tu saliang maibua jo carito masiang-masiang tentang kampuang nyo surang-surang, mancaritoan aksennyo nan babeda-beda jo dialek lokalnyo.
eng_text: They're regaling each other with stories from their hometowns, told in their distinct accents and local argot.

text: Mambali makanan di supermarket biasonyo caro nan paliang murah untuak mancari makan. Kalau indak talakik mamasak, pilihannyo tantu tabateh jo makanan nan siap saji.
eng_text: Buying food in supermarkets is usually the cheapest way to get fed. Without cooking opportunities, choices are however limited to ready-made food.

text: Maningkeknyo jumlah supermarket maakibaikan baragamnyo pilihan makanan siap saji. Babarapo supermarket bahkan manyadioan open microwave untuak maangekan makanan.
eng_text: Increasingly supermarkets are getting a more varied section of ready-made food. Some even provide a microwave oven or other means to heat food.

text: DI babarapo nagara atau di kadai-kadai nan ado paliang indak ciek tampek makan di ditampek, biasonyo rumah makan tu indak resmi dan haragonyo tajangkau.
eng_text: In some countries or types of stores there is at least one on-site restaurant, often a rather informal one with affordable prices.

text: Buek dan baok kopian hukum dan kontak asuransi dunsanak.
eng_text: Make and carry copies of your policy and your insurer's contact details with you.

text: Urang tu paralu untuak manunjuak alamaik email dan nombor talepon internasinal untuak saran/izin dan mambuek klaim.
eng_text: They need to show the insurer's e-mail address and international phone numbers for advice/authorizations and making claims.

text: Pastian dunsanak ado kopian lain dalam bagasi dan sacaro online (kiriman email ka dunsanak sorang barikuik lampirannyo, atau simpan di "cloud").
eng_text: Have another copy in your luggage and online (e-mail to yourself with attachment, or stored in the "cloud").

text: Jikokk bapajalanan jo laptop atau jo tablet, simpan kopiannyo di dalam memori atau di disc (nan bisa diakses tanpa ado internet).
eng_text: If traveling with a laptop or tablet, store a copy in its memory or disc (accessible without the internet).

text: Kamudian juo agiahan kopian aturan/kontak ka pandampiang pajalanan dan ka sanak atau ka kawan nan namuah mambantu di rumah.
eng_text: Also give policy/contact copies to traveling companions and relatives or friends back home willing to help.

text: Moose (atau biaso disabuik jo elk) indaklah taruih-taruihan agresif, namun akan mambela dirinyo bilo inyo mandapek ancaman.
eng_text: Moose (also known as elk) aren't inherently aggressive, but will defend themselves if they perceive a threat.

text: Katiko urang-urang indak maanggap moose bapotensi babayo, inyo dapek talampau mandakek dan mambuek dirinyo tarancam.
eng_text: When people don't see moose as potentially dangerous, they may approach too closely and put themselves at risk.

text: Minumlah minuman alkohol dengan indak bakalabiahan. Alkohol bapangaruah satiok urang sacaro babeda, dan mangatahui batehnyo dunsanak sangaiklah pantiang.
eng_text: Drink alcoholic drinks with moderation. Alcohol affects everyone differently, and knowing your limit is very important.

text: Kajadian kamungkinan kasiatan jangko panjang dari minum bakalabiahan bisa maliputi karusakan hati dan malah buto jo kamatian. Bahayo potensia maningkek katiko mananggak alkohol nan dibuek sacaro ilegal.
eng_text: Possible long term health events from excessive drinking can include liver damage and even blindness and death. The potential danger is increased when consuming illegally produced alcohol.

text: Spirit nan ilegal bisa manganduang babagai macam kotoran babahayo tamsuak metanol, yang bisa maakibaikan kabutoan atau kamatian bahkan dalam dosis saketek.
eng_text: Illegal spirits can contain various dangerous impurities including methanol, which can cause blindness or death even in small doses.

text: Kacomato bisa labiah murah di lua nagari, apolai di nagara bapandapatan randah di mano upah urang bakarajo labiah randah.
eng_text: Eyeglasses can be cheaper in a foreign country, especially in low-income countries where labour costs are lower.

text: Patimbanganlah mandapek pamaresoan mato di rumah, khususnyo kalau asuransi manangguangnyo, dan mambao resep sarato untuak diarsipkan di tampek lain.
eng_text: Consider getting an eye exam at home, especially if insurance covers it, and bringing the prescription along to be filed elsewhere.

text: Bingkai namo merek mewah nan tasidio di daerah-daerah samacam itu bisa punyo duo masalah; babaraponyo bisa jadi barang tiruan, dan nan asli diimpor bisa jadi labiah maha dibandiang jo nan di dalam nagari.
eng_text: High-end brand-name frames available in such areas may have two problems; some may be knock-offs, and the real imported ones may be more expensive than at home.

text: Kopi adolah salah satu barang dagang paliang banyak digalehan sadunia, dan dunsanak mungkin dapek basuo banyak ragamnyo di daerah kampuang dunsanyak.
eng_text: Coffee is one of the world's most traded commodities, and you can probably find many types in your home region.

text: Walau pun baitu, ado banyak caro khusus maminum kopi di saluruah dunia nan patuik dicubo.
eng_text: Nevertheless, there are many distinctive ways of drinking coffee around the world that are worth experiencing.

text: Batualang di ngarai (atau: canyoneering) adolah tantang bajalan ka dalam bawahnyo ngarai, nan mano baiak itu kariang atau panuah dek aia.
eng_text: Canyoning (or: canyoneering) is about going in a bottom of a canyon, which is either dry or full of water.

text: Batualang ngarai manggabuangan bagian-bagian dari baranang, mamanjek dan malompek—tapi paralu agaknyo saketek latian atau kondisi badan untuk mamulai (dibandiang jo panjek tabiang, selam skuba atau ski alpen, misalnyo).
eng_text: Canyoning combines elements from swimming, climbing and jumping--but requires relatively little training or physical shape to get started (compared to rock climbing, scuba diving or alpine skiing, for example).

text: Mandaki adolah kagiatan lua ruangan nan tamasuak di dalamnyo bajalan kaki di lingkuangan alam, acoknyo di jalur mandaki.
eng_text: Hiking is an outdoor activity which consists of walking in natural environments, often on hiking trails.

text: Hiking sahari malibaikan jarak nan kurang dari samil hinggo jarak nan labuah jauah nan bisa ditampuah dalam sahari sajo.
eng_text: Day hiking involves distances of less than a mile up to longer distances that can be covered in a single day.

text: Untuak mandaki sahari sapanjang jalur nan mudah saketek pasiapan diparaluan, dan siapo sajo urang nan cukuik sihaik bisa manikmatinyo.
eng_text: For a day hike along an easy trail little preparations are needed, and any moderately fit person can enjoy them.

text: Kaluarga nan baranak ketek mungkin paralu labiah basiap-siap, tapi sahari di lua rumah bisa mudah dikarajoan malah sarato bayi jo anak-anak alun sakola.
eng_text: Families with small children may need more preparations, but a day outdoors is easily possible even with babies and pre-school children.

text: Sacaro internasional, ado hampia 200 organisasi tur nan aktif. Kabanyakannyo bakarajo sacaro mandiri.
eng_text: Internationally, there are nearly 200 running tour organizations. Most of them operate independently.

text: Panaruih Global Running Tours, Go Running Tours maubuangan lusinan panyadio sightrunning di ampek banua.
eng_text: The Global Running Tours successor, Go Running Tours networks dozens of sightrunning providers on four continents.

text: Barasa di Running Tours Barcelonanyo Barcelona dan Running Copenhagennyo Copenhagen, sacapeknyo bagabuang pulo Running Tours Prague barasa di Praha dan lainnyo.
eng_text: With roots in Barcelona's Running Tours Barcelona and Copenhagen's Running Copenhagen, it was quickly joined by Running Tours Prague based in Prague and others.

text: Ado banyak hal nan harus dunsanak patimbangan sabalum dan katiko dunsanak pai bajalan ka suatu tampek.
eng_text: There are many things you have to take into consideration before and when you travel somewhere.

text: Katiko dunsanak bajalan-jalan, antisipasilah hal-hal nan indak samo jo "di rumah". Kasopanan, aturan, makanan, lalu linteh, panginapan, ukuran norma, bahaso dan sataruihnyo akan babeda sampai bateh tatantu jo di tampek dunsanak tingga.
eng_text: When you travel, expect things not to be like they are "back home". Manners, laws, food, traffic, lodging, standards, language and so on will to some extent differ from where you live.

text: Ado hal nan dunsanak paralu taruih inokan dalam banak, untuak mailakan kakacewaan atau mungkin ilang salero taadok panduduak satampek batingkah laku.
eng_text: This is something you always need to keep in mind, to avoid disappointment or perhaps even distaste over local ways to do things.

text: Agensi travel alah ado samanjak abaik 19. Agen travel biasonyo piliahan nan rancak untuak pajalanan nan balanjuik malampaui pangalaman si turih sabalumnyo tantang alam, budayo, bahaso atau nagara bapandapatan randah.
eng_text: Travel agencies have been around since the 19th century. A travel agent is usually a good option for a journey which extends beyond a traveller's previous experience of nature, culture, language or low-income countries.

text: Walaupun kabanyakan agen basadio maambiak pamasanan paliang reguler, banyak agen nan ahli dalam tipe pajalanan khusus, kisaran anggaran atau tujuan.
eng_text: Although most agencies are willing to take on most regular bookings, many agents specialise in particular types of travel, budget ranges or destinations.

text: Bisa labiah baiak mamakai agen nan acok manjadwalan pajalanan nan mirip jo dunsanak.
eng_text: It can be better to use an agent who frequently books similar trips to yours.

text: Paratikanlah pajalanan apo nan agen tu promosikan, antah di situsnyo atau di jandela tokonyo.
eng_text: Take a look at what trips the agent is promoting, whether on a website or in a shop window.

text: Jikok dunsanak nio mancaliak dunia jo gaya iduik murah, demi kaharusan, atau tantangan, ado babarapo caro untuak itu.
eng_text: If you want to see the world on the cheap, for necessity, lifestyle or challenge, there are some ways to do that.

text: Pado dasarnyo, inyo masuak dalam duo kategori: bakarajo sambia dunsanak bawisata atau mancubo dan mangurangi pangaluaran dunsanak. Tulisan iko tacurah la nan taakia tu.
eng_text: Basically, they fall into two categories: Either work while you travel or try and limit your expenses. This article is focused on the latter.

text: Untuak urang nan nio mangorbanan kanyamanan, wakatu dan kamungkinan bisa kiro-kiro manakan pangaluaran sampai nol, caliaklah pajalanan imaik anggaran.
eng_text: For those willing to sacrifice comfort, time and predictability to push expenses down close to zero, see minimum budget travel.

text: Nasehaik tu mangiro bahasonyo turih-turih janlah mancilok, masuak indak pakai izin, sato dalam pasa talarang, mamintak-mintak, atau kalau indak mamanfaatkan urang lain untuak kauntuangannyo surang.
eng_text: The advice assumes that travellers do not steal, trespass, participate in the illegal market, beg, or otherwise exploit other people for their own gain.

text: Suatu pos pamaresoan imigrasi biasonyo adolah pambarantian partamo katiko turun dari kapa tabang, kapa lauik, atau kandaraan lainnyo.
eng_text: An immigration checkpoint is usually the first stop when disembarking from a plane, a ship, or another vehicle.

text: Di babarapo kareta linteh-bateh inspeksi dikarajoan wakatu kareta bajalan dan dunsanak mustilah mambao kartu identitas wakatu manumpang naiak di salah satu kareta tu.
eng_text: In some cross-border trains inspections are done on the running train and you should have valid ID with you when boarding one of those trains.

text: Di kareta lalok malam, paspor mungkin dikumpuan dek konduktor sahinggo lalok dunsanak indak harus tagaduah.
eng_text: On night sleeper trains, passports may be collected by the conductor so that you do not have your sleep interrupted.

text: Pandaftaran adolah syarat tambahan untuak proses pangajuan visa. Di babarapo nagara, dunsanak musti mandaftar kahadiran dan alamat dimano dunsanak tingga jo otoritas satampek.
eng_text: Registration is an additional requirement for the visa process. In some countries, you must register your presence and address where you are staying with the local authorities.

text: Hal iko mungkin mawajiban maisi pormulir jo polisi satampek atau kunjuangan ka kantua imigrasi.
eng_text: This might require filling out a form with the local police or a visit to the immigration offices.

text: Di babarapo nagara jo paraturan sarupo itu, otel satampek nan ka manangani pandaftaran (pastian untuak batanyo).
eng_text: In many countries with such a law, local hotels will handle the registration (make sure to ask).

text: Di babarapo kasus, hanyo turih nan tingga di lua akomodasi turih paralu mandaftar. Namun, hal iko mambuek paraturan tu manjadi indak jaleh, jadi cari taulah sabalumnyo.
eng_text: In other cases, only those staying outside of tourist accommodations need to register.  However, this makes the law much more obscure, so find out beforehand.

text: Arsitektur mandalami parancangan dan konstruksi bangunan. Arsitektur suatu tampek acoknyo adolah atraksi turih dalam halnyo tasandiri.
eng_text: Architecture is concerned with the design and construction of buildings. The architecture of a place is often a tourist attraction in its own right.

text: Banyak bangunan cukuik indah untuak dicaliak dan panorama dari bangunan tinggi atau dari jandela nan santiang panampekannyo dapek manjadi kaindahan untuak dipandang.
eng_text: Many buildings are quite beautiful to look at and the view from a tall building or from a cleverly-positioned window can be a beauty to behold.

text: Arsitektur banyak basingguangan jo bidang lain tamasuak parancangan kota, teknik sipil, seni dekorasi, desain interior dan desain lansekap.
eng_text: Architecture overlaps considerably with other fields including urban planning, civil engineering, decorative arts, interior design and landscape design.

text: Mancaliak baa lah tapancianyo banyak kampuang-kampuang ko, dunsanak indak ka dapek basuo sajumlah gadang kahidupan malam kok indak malala ka Albuquerque atau Santa Fe.
eng_text: Given how remote many of the pueblos are, you won't be able to find a significant amount of nightlife without traveling to Albuquerque or Santa Fe.

text: Namun, ampia sadoalah kasino nan tacatat di ateh manyadioan minuman, dan babarapo di antaronyo mambao merek namo hiburan (tarutamo nan gadang tu lanteh mangaliliangi Albuquerque jo Santa Fe).
eng_text: However, nearly all of the casinos listed above serve drinks, and several of them bring in name-brand entertainment (primarily the large ones immediately surrounding Albuquerque and Santa Fe).

text: Hati-hati: bar kota ketek di siko indaklah salalu jadi tampek nan sero untuak pangunjuang lua nagara bagian untuak duduak basantai.
eng_text: Beware: small-town bars here are not always good places for the out-of-state visitor to hang out.

text: Untuak ciek hal, Meksiko Baru sabalah utaro punyo masalah serius jo mabuak sambia mangamudi, jo jumlah sopir mabuak nan tinggi dakek jo bar kota ketek.
eng_text: For one thing, northern New Mexico has significant problems with drunk driving, and the concentration of intoxicated drivers is high close to small-town bars.

text: Gambar di dindiang atau coreang nan indak dikandaki disabuik juo jo grafiti.
eng_text: Unwanted murals or scribble is known as graffiti.

text: Di sampiang kajadian ko jauah dari penomena di maso moderen, banyak urang nan maanggap iko sabagai hasia karajo anak-anak mudo mada nan marusak pasilitas pripat dan umum manggunoan caik tembak.
eng_text: While it's far from a modern phenomenon, most people probably associate it with youth vandalizing public and private property using spray paint.

text: Namun, akhia-akhia ko muncul seniman grafiti, acara-acara grafiti dan dindiang nan "dibuliahan". Asia lukih grafiti dalam hal ko acok manggambaran kasenian dibandiang tando-tando nan indak tabaco.
eng_text: However, nowadays there are established graffiti artists, graffiti events and "legal" walls. Graffiti paintings in this context often resemble artworks rather than illegible tags.

text: Malantiangan bumerang adolah kamampuan tanamo nan banyak turis ingin pandai malakuannyo.
eng_text: Boomerang throwing is a popular skill that many tourists want to acquire.

text: Jikok dunsanak nio baraja malantiangan bumerang nan bisa baliak ka tangan dunsanak, pastian dunsanak punyo bumerang nan cocok untuak bisa babaliak.
eng_text: If you want to learn throwing a boomerang that comes back to your hand, make sure you have a suitable boomerang for returning.

text: Kabanyakan bumerang nan tasadio di Australia sabananyo indak bisa babaliak. Sarancaknyo untuak nan baru mulai jan cubo malantiangannyo di hari barangin
eng_text: Most boomerangs available in Australia are in fact non-returning. It is best for beginners to not try throwing in windy

text: Hangi adolah makanan nan dimasak didalam lubang angek di tanah.
eng_text: A Hangi Meal is cooked in a hot pit in the ground.

text: Lubang tu diangek an jo batu nan dibaka diapi, atau di tampek nan ado angek dari bumi nan mambuek tanah di daerah tu angek sacaro alami.
eng_text: The pit is either heated with hot stones from a fire, or in some places geothermal heat makes areas of ground naturally hot.

text: Hangi biasonyo digunoan untuak mamasak makanan tradisional jo caro dipanggang.
eng_text: The hangi is often used to cook a traditional roast style dinner.

text: Babarapo tampek di Roturua manawaran hangi nan dibuek dari paneh alami bumi, sadangkan hangi nan lain bisa dikicok di Christchurch, Wellington dan di tampek lain.
eng_text: Several places in Rotorua offer geothermal hangi, while other hangi can be sampled in Christchurch, Wellington and elsewhere.

text: MetroRail punyo duo kelaih kareta panumpang untuak di dalam dan sakaliliang Cape Town: MetroPlus (juo disabuik Kelaih Patamo) dan Metro (disabuik Kelaih Katigo).
eng_text: MetroRail has two classes on commuter trains in and around Cape Town: MetroPlus (also called First Class) and Metro (called Third Class).

eng_text: MetroPlus is more comfortable and less crowded but slightly more expensive, though still cheaper than normal metro tickets in Europe.

eng_text: Every train has both MetroPlus and Metro coaches; the MetroPlus coaches are always on the end of the train nearest Cape Town.

eng_text: Carrying for others - Never let your bags out of your sight, especially when you are crossing international borders.

eng_text: You could find yourself being used as a drug carrier without your knowledge, which will land you in a great deal of trouble.

eng_text: This includes waiting in line, as drug-sniffing dogs could be used at any time without notice.

eng_text: Some countries have exceedingly draconian punishments even for first time offenses; these can include prison sentences of over 10 years or death.

eng_text: Unattended bags are a target for theft and can also attract attention from authorities wary of bomb threats.

eng_text: At home, due to this constant exposure to the local germs, odds are very high that you're already immune to them.

eng_text: But in other parts of the world, where the bacteriological fauna are new to you, you're far more likely to run into problems.

eng_text: Also, in warmer climates bacteria both grow more quickly and survive longer outside the body.
