eng_text: Thus the scourges of Delhi Belly, the Pharaoh's Curse, Montezuma's Revenge, and their many friends.

text: Bantuak masalah panapasan di cuaca nan labiah dingin, masalah paruik di nagari bacuaca angek biasonyo umum dan di banyak kajadian sangaik manggaduah tapi indak babahayo bana.
eng_text: As with respiratory problems in colder climates, intestinal problems in hot climates are fairly common and in most cases are distinctly annoying but not really dangerous.

text: Jikokk patamo kali bapajalanan di nagara bakambang – atau di bagian baru di dunia – jan pernah remehan kamungkinan tajadinyo gaga budayo.
eng_text: If traveling in a developing country for the first time – or in a new part of the world – don't underestimate the potential culture shock.

text: Banyak panjalajah nan alah stabil dan cakap alah mangatasi kabaruan dari pajalanan ka dunia bakambang, dima banyak panyasuaian budayo bisa capek batambah.
eng_text: Many a stable, capable traveler has been overcome by the newness of developing world travel, where many little cultural adjustments can add up quickly.

text: Tarutamo di hari-hari patamo dunsanak, pikian kamungkinan manggunoan pitih untuak hotel bakualitas - bagaya baraik, makanan, dan layanan untuak manyasuaian diri jo cuaca.
eng_text: Especially in your initial days, consider splurging on Western-style and -quality hotels, food, and services to help acclimatize.

text: Jan lalok di ateh lapiak atau banta-banta di lantai sabab dunsanak indak tahu jo hewan lokal disinan.
eng_text: Do not sleep on a mattress or pad on the ground in areas where you do not know the local fauna.

text: Jikokk dunsanak nio pai kemah kalua, baok kasua lipek atau kasua gantuang untuak manjauahan dunsanak dari ula, kalo dan sajinihnyo.
eng_text: If you are going to camp out, bring a camp cot or hammock to keep you away from snakes, scorpions and such.

text: Isi rumah dunsanak jo kopi nan lamak di pagi ari jo babarapo teh kamomil nan mananangan di malam ari.
eng_text: Fill your home with a rich coffee in the morning and some relaxing chamomile tea at night.

text: Katiko dunsanak sadang manginap, dunsanak punyo wakatu untuak marawaik diri dan maambiak wakatu babarapo minik untuak mambuek sabuah hal nan spesial.
eng_text: When you're on a staycation, you have the time to treat yourself and take a few extra minutes to brew up something special.

text: Jikokk dunsanak patualang, ambiak kasempatan untuak mambuek jus atau smuthi:
eng_text: If you're feeling more adventurous, take the opportunity to juice or blend up some smoothies:

text: Mungkin dunsanak akan manamuan minuman sadarano nan bisa dunsanak buek untuak sarapan pagi katiko dunsanak baliak dari kagiatan kasaharian dunsanak.
eng_text: maybe you'll discover a simple beverage that you can make for breakfast when you're back to your daily routine.

text: Katiko dunsanak tingga di kota nan punyo budayo minum nan baragam, pai ka kadai minum atau pub di lingkuangan nan jarang sanak kunjuangi.
eng_text: If you live in a city with a varied drinking culture, go to bars or pubs in neighborhoods you don't frequent.

text: Untuak dunsanak nan indak biaso jo salogan kasehatan, kato mudah mainfeksi jo kato mudah manular tu punyo arati nan babeda.
eng_text: For those unfamiliar with medical jargon, the words infectious and contagious have distinct meanings.

text: Panyakik nan manular adolah nan disababan dek patogen, bantuak virus, bakteri, cindawan, atau binalu lain.
eng_text: An infectious disease is one that is caused by a pathogen, such as a virus, bacterium, fungus or other parasites.

text: Panyakik nan mudah manular tu adolah panyakik nan sacaro mudah bisa disebaran ka sekitar atau dari urang nan kanai panyakik tu.
eng_text: A contagious disease is a disease which is easily transmitted by being in the vicinity of an infected person.

text: Banyak pamarintahan mawajiban pangunjuang nan masuak, atau pangunjuang nan kalua, dari nagari tu harus divaksin untuak ragam panyakik tatantu.
eng_text: Many governments require visitors entering, or residents leaving, their countries to be vaccinated for a range of diseases.

text: Kawajiban tu tagantuang jo nagara ma nan alah dikunjuangi atau ka nagara ma kunjuangan akan dilakukan panjalajah.
eng_text: These requirements may often depend on what countries a traveller has visited or intends to visit.

text: Salah ciek kalabiahan dari Charlotte, Carolina Utara adolah balimpahnyo pilihan nan bakualitas tinggi untuak keluarga.
eng_text: One of strong points of Charlotte, North Carolina, is that it has an abundance of high-quality options for families.

text: Residen dari daerah lain acok mangutip ramah-keluarga sabagai alasan utamo untuak pindah kasinan, dan tamu baranggapan kota mudah dinikmati basamo anak-anak di sakaliliang.
eng_text: Residents from other areas often cite family-friendliness as a primary reason for moving there, and visitors often find the city easy to enjoy with children around.

text: Dalam 20 taun belakang ko, jumlah pilihan ramah anak di pusat kota Charlotte tumbuah kancang.
eng_text: In the past 20 years, the amount of child-friendly options in Uptown Charlotte has grown exponentially.

text: Taksi biasonyo indak digunoan dek keluarga di Charlotte, walau akhirnyo bisa juo digunoan dalam kaadaan khusus.
eng_text: Taxis are not generally used by families in Charlotte, though they can be of some use in certain circumstances.

text: Ado ongkos tambahan kalau labiah dari 2 panumpang, jadi pilihan ko labiah maha dari nan diparaluan.
eng_text: There is a surcharge for having more than 2 passengers, so this option might be more expensive than necessary.

text: Antarktika marupokan tampek paliang dingin di bumi dan mangaliliangi Kutub Selatan.
eng_text: Antarctica is the coldest place on Earth, and surrounds the South Pole.

text: Kunjuangan untuak turis haragonyo maha, paralu kasehatan pisik, hanyo bisa dilakuan di musim paneh bulan Nov-Feb dan sabagian banyak tabateh hanyo di Semenanjuang, Kepulauan jo Lauik Ross.
eng_text: Tourist visits are costly, demand physical fitness, can only take place in summer Nov-Feb, and are largely limited to the Peninsula, Islands and Ross Sea.

text: Saribuan staf tingga di siko salamo musim paneh di sakitaran ampek lusin pangkalan di area situ, sabagian ketek dari mereka tingga salamo musim dingin.
eng_text: A couple of thousand staff live here in summer in some four dozen bases mostly in those areas; a small number stay over winter.

text: Padalaman Antarktika marupokan dataran tinggi tapancia nan tatutuik dek 2-3 km es.
eng_text: Inland Antarctica is a desolate plateau covered by 2-3 km of ice.

text: Tur udaro spesialis sasakali pai ka area pedalaman untuak mandaki gunuang atau mancapai Kutub, nan punyo pangkalan gadang.
eng_text: Occasional specialist air tours go inland, for mountaineering or to reach the Pole, which has a large base.

text: Palintehan kutub salatan (atau jalan raya) adolah jalur sapanjang 1600 km dari Stasiun McMurdo di Lauik Ross ka pusat kutub.
eng_text: The South Pole Traverse (or Highway) is a 1600 km trail from McMurdo Station on the Ross Sea to the Pole.

text: Itu adolah salju padek nan maisi salo dan ditandoan jo bandera-bandera. Hanyo bisa dikunjuangi jo traktor khusus, kareta luncua nan mambao minyak jo baka.
eng_text: It's compacted snow with crevasses filled in and marked by flags. It can only be traveled by specialized tractors, hauling sleds with fuel and supplies.

text: Kareta tu indak lincah sainggo arus maambiak jalan mamuta ka pagunuangan Transantarktika untuak sampai ka dataran tinggi.
eng_text: These aren't very nimble so the trail has to take a long swerve around the Transantarctic Mountains to come onto the plateau.

text: Sabab utamo dari kacalakaan di musim dingin adolah jalan nan licin, trotoar dan tarutamo jalan satapak.
eng_text: The most common cause for accidents in winter is slippery roads, pavements (sidewalks) and especially steps.

text: Paliang kurang, dunsanak paralu aleh kaki nan tapak dalamnyo pas. Sapatu musim paneh biasonyo licin di ateh es dan salju, bahkan babarapo sapatu boot musim dingin juo masih alun cukuik.
eng_text: At a minimum, you need footwear with suitable soles. Summer shoes are usually very slippery on ice and snow, even some winter boots are deficient.

text: Polanyo arusnyo cukuik dalam, 5 mm (1/5 inci) atau labiah, dan bahannyo cukuik aluih di suhu nan dingin.
eng_text: The pattern should be deep enough, 5 mm (1/5 inch) or more, and the material soft enough in cold temperatures.

text: Babarapo sapatu boot ado kanciangnyo dan ado tambahan palangkok an kanciang untuak kondisi nan licin, cocok untuak sado sapatu dan sapatu boot, untuak tumik atau tumik jo aleh kaki dalam.
eng_text: Some boots have studs and there is studded add-on equipment for slippery conditions, suitable for most shoes and boots, for the heels or heels and sole.

text: Untuak bagian tumik haruih randah dan leba. Kasiak, kareke atau garam (kalsium klorida) acok baserak di jalan atau jalan satapak tujuannyo untuak manambah dayo lakek.
eng_text: Heels should be low and wide. Sand, gravel or salt (calcium chloride) is often scattered on roads or paths to improve traction.

text: Longsoran salju bukan hal nan indak wajar; turunan nan curam hanyo bisa manahan saketek, dan volume salabiahnyo akan jatuah sabagai longsoran salju.
eng_text: Avalanches are not an abnormality; steep slopes can hold only so much slow, and the excess volumes will come down as avalanches.

text: Masalahnyo adolah salju tu lakek, jadi arus ado samacam pamanciang untuaknyo jatuah, dan kadang babarapo salju nan jatuah bisa jadi pamanciang untuak longsoran salju sisonyo.
eng_text: The problem is that snow is sticky, so it needs some triggering to come down, and some snow coming down can be the triggering event for the rest.

text: Kadang pamanciang tajadinyo longsoran salju adolah matohari nan maangek an salju, kadang hujan salju, kadang juo dek karano sabab alami lain, acok juo dek manusia.
eng_text: Sometimes the original trigging event is the sun warming the snow, sometimes some more snowfall, sometimes other natural events, often a human.

text: Angin topan adolah putaran kolom angin batekanan randah, nan maisok udaro di sakuliliangnyo ka arah dalam dan ka arah ateh.
eng_text: A tornado is a spinning column of very low-pressure air, which sucks the surrounding air inward and upward.

text: Angin tu maasiaan angin kancang (acok kali 100-200 mil/jam) dan bisa maangkek bando barek ka udaro, mambaonyo bairiangan jo garik angin topan.
eng_text: They generate high winds (often 100-200 miles/hour) and can lift heavy objects into the air, carrying them as the tornado moves.

text: Bamulo dari corong nan tabantuak dari awan badai, dan katiko nyo sampai ditanah manjadi "tornado".
eng_text: They begin as funnels descending from storm clouds, and become "tornadoes" when they touch the ground.

text: VPN (virtual private network) pribadi manyadioan solusi nan rancak untuak maindaan dari sensor politik dan panyaringan IP geograpis komersial.
eng_text: Personal VPN (virtual private network) providers are an excellent way of circumventing both political censorship and commercial IP-geofiltering.

text: Untuak babarapo alasan urang tu mampunyoi kuaso tahadok web proxies: inyo manguasoi lalu linteh internet, indak hanyo htpp.
eng_text: They are superior to web proxies for several reasons: They re-route all Internet traffic, not only http.

text: Biasonyo urang tu manawaran harago nan labiah tinggi dan palayanan kualiteh nan rancak. Inyo takunci sahinggo sulik untuak dimato matoi.
eng_text: They normally offer higher bandwidth and better quality of service. They are encrypted and thus harder to spy on.

text: Banyak parusahaan madia nan baduto tantang mukasuik iko, mangecekan baaso iko untuak "mancegah pambajakan".
eng_text: The media companies routinely lie about the purpose of this, claiming that it is to "prevent piracy".

text: Kanyataannyo, kode wilayah indak punyo pangaruah ka panyalinan indak sah; saketek-demi- saketek disalin dari disk nyo dan akan baputa dangan lanca di parangkaik manopun.
eng_text: In fact, region codes have absolutely no effect on illegal copying; a bit-for-bit copy of a disk will play just fine on any device where the original will.

text: Mukasuik nan subananyo adolah maagihan kandali labiah ka parusahaan ateh pasanyo; iko sadoannyo hanyo soal pitih nan baputa.
eng_text: The actual purpose is to give those companies more control over their markets; it's all about money spinning.

text: Karano kasadoan talepon dipindahan ka internet, dunsanak indak paralu manggunoan parusahaan talepon di dakek dunsanak tingga atau dima dunsanak barado.
eng_text: Because calls are routed over the Internet, you do not need to use a phone company located where you live or where you travel.

text: Indak ado syaraik baaso dunsanak haruih mandapekan nombor lokal masyarakat satampek; dunsanak bisa mandapekan nyo dari koneksi internet di tampek lia bantuak Chickens, Alaska dan mamiliah ciek nomor nan mangatoan dunsanak barado di Arizona nan sadang tarang.
eng_text: There is also no requirement that you obtain a local number from the community in which you live; you can obtain a satellite Internet connection in the wilds of Chicken, Alaska and select a number which claims you're in sunny Arizona.

text: Acok, katiko dunsanak mambali sabuah nombor global sacaro tapisah mamungkinan talepon PSTN manalepon dunsanak. Dima nomor nan manalepon tu babeda untuak satiok urang.
eng_text: Often, you have to buy a global number separately that allows PSTN phones to call you. Where the number is from makes a difference for people calling you.

text: Aplikasi panarjamah teks Real-time – aplikasi tu mampu maartian sacaro otomatis teks utuah dari ciek bahaso ka bahaso lainnyo.
eng_text: Real-time text translator apps – applications that are capable of automatically translating whole segments of text from one language into another.

text: Babarapo aplikasi di kalompok ko bahkan bisa maartian teks dari bahaso asiang atau objek lainnyo nan ado di dunia ko katiko panggunonyo maarahan hape android ka arah objek tu.
eng_text: Some of the applications in this category can even translate texts in foreign languages on signs or other objects in the real world when the user points the smartphone towards those objects.

text: Masin panarjamah alah samakin maningkek, dan kini ado nan bisa maagiah tau kurang labiah dari panajamah nan batuanyo (dan iko indak sakada baduto), tatapi babarapo hal paralu diparatian, atau itu ka manjadi salah sadoannyo.
eng_text: The translation engines have improved dramatically, and now often give more or less correct translations (and more seldom gibberish), but some care is due, as they still may have gotten it all wrong.

text: Salah satu aplikasi nan paliang manonjol di kalompok ko adolah Google Translate, dimano bisa manerjamahan sacaro offline sasudah mandownload data bahaso nan diinginan.
eng_text: One of the most prominent apps in this category is Google Translate, which allows offline translation after downloading the desired language data.

text: Manggunoan aplikasi navigasi GPS di hape android ko bisa mamudahan dan mambuek pajalanan dunsanak labiah sanang katiko pai dari nagari asa dunsanak.
eng_text: Using GPS navigation apps on your smartphone can be the easiest and most convenient way to navigate when out of your home country.

text: Bisa labiah maemaik pitih katiko mambali peta baru dari GPS, atau sabuah GPS mandiri dari parangkaik atau manyeo ciek oto dari parusahaan rental.
eng_text: It can save money over buying new maps for a GPS, or a standalone GPS device or renting one from a car rental company.

text: Katiko dunsanak indak punyo sambuangan data di talepon, atau di lua jangkauan, kinerjanyo bisa tabateh atau indak bisa samo sakali.
eng_text: If you don't have a data connection for your phone, or when it is out of range, their performance can be limited or unavailable.

text: Di satiok suduik tampek pabalanjoan ado tampek nan mambinguangan karano ado deretan kartu talepon pra-bayia nan bisa digunoan untuak talepon umum atau talepon biaso.
eng_text: Every corner store is filled with a confusing array of pre-paid phone cards that can be used from pay phones or ordinary telephones.

text: Katiko ado babarapo karatu bisa manalepon dima sajo, babarapo layanan fokus ka manyadioan panggilan jo biaya nan murah ka babarapo kalompok nagari.
eng_text: While most cards are good for calling anywhere, some specialise in providing favourable call rates to specific groups of countries.

text: Akses ka palayanan malalui talepon perai nan bisa di talepon dari hampia saluruah talepon tanpa ado cas biaya.
eng_text: Access to these services is often through a toll-free telephone number that can be called from most phones without charge.

text: Aturan mangenai fotografi umum juo balaku untuak parekaman video, kamungkinan labiah atau samacam tu.
eng_text: Rules regarding regular photography also apply to video recording, possibly even more so.

text: Jikok dunsanak maambiak foto ditampek nan indak diizinan maambiak foto, mangko jan dunsanak pikia maambiak video akan buliah lo.
eng_text: If just taking a photo of something isn't allowed, then you shouldn't even think of recording a video of it.

text: Jikok manggunoan drone, pareso bana labiah dulu apo sajo nan dunsanak buliah rekam jo apo ijin atau lisensi tambahan nan paralu.
eng_text: If using a drone, check well in advance as to what you are allowed to film and what permits or additional licensing are required.

text: Manabangan drone di dakek bandara atau di tampek urang rami marupoan pilihan nan buruak, bahkan walau itu indak dilarang di daerah dunsanak.
eng_text: Flying a drone near an airport or over a crowd is almost always a bad idea, even if it's not illegal in your area.

text: Akhia-akhia ko, parjalanan udaro jarang dipasan malalui parusahaan kapa tabang sabalun dibanding jo dicari haragonyo talabiah dahulu.
eng_text: Nowadays air travel is only rarely booked directly through the airline without first searching and comparing prices.

text: Kadang panabangan nan samo bisa jauah bana beda haragonyo di baragam ulehan urang sahinggo akan untuang bana untuak mambandiangan hasil pancarian dan juo mancaliak ka website panabangan sabalun mamasan.
eng_text: Sometimes the same flight can have vastly differing prices at various agregators and it pays to compare search results and to also look at the website of the airline itself before booking.

text: Visa mungkin indak paralu untuk kunjuangan singkek ka nagara-nagara tatantu sabagai turis atau untuak bisnis, tapi pai sabagai murik internasional biasonyo musti tingga labiah lamo daripado turis biaso.
eng_text: While you may not need a visa for short visits to certain countries as a tourist or for business, going there as an international student generally requires a longer stay than going there just as a casual tourist.

text: Biasonyo, tingga di lua nagari untuak periode nan lamo mangko dunsanak diwajiban untuak mandapekan visa.
eng_text: In general, staying in any foreign country for an extended period of time will require you to obtain a visa in advance.

text: Visa murik biasonyo punyo saraik-saraik jo langkah pamohonan babeda dari visa turis atau bisnis biaso.
eng_text: Student visas generally have different requirements and application procedures from normal tourist or business visas.

text: Untuak kabanyakan nagara, dunsanak paralu surek panawaran dari limbago tampek nio baraja, jo bukti punyo modal pribadi untuak tahun partamo sakola.
eng_text: For most countries, you will need an offer letter from the institution you wish to study at, and also evidence of funds to support yourself for at least the first year of your course.

text: Pareso persyaratan nan jaleh dari lambaga tu, baitu pulo departemen imigrasi dari nagara tampek dunsanak nio baraja.
eng_text: Check with the institution, as well as the immigration department for the country you wish to study in for detailed requirements.

text: Kacuali jikok dunsanak adolah diplomaik, karajo di lua nagari artinyo dunsanak haruih mandata pajak pamasukan dari nagari asa dunsanak.
eng_text: Unless you are a diplomat, working overseas generally means that you will have to file income tax in the country you are based in.

text: Pajak pamasukan punyo struktur nan babeda-beda di satiok nagara, dan nilai pajak baragam dari ciek nagara ka nagara lain.
eng_text: Income tax is structured differently in different countries, and the tax rates and brackets vary widely from one country to another.

text: Di babarapo nagara federal, bantuak Amerika dan kanada, pajak pamasukan dipunguik dari level federal dan level lokal, sahinggo taraf nilai pajaknyo bisa baragam dari ciek daerah ka daerah lain.
eng_text: In some federal countries, such as the United States and Canada, income tax is levied both at the federal level and at the local level, so the rates and brackets can vary from region to region.

text: Katiko dipareso imigrasi dan biasonyo ambiak absen katiko dunsanak baliak ka nagari asa, mangko pamaresoan bea cukai bisa jadi marepotan.
eng_text: While immigration check is usually absent or a formality when you arrive in your homeland, customs control can be a hassle.

text: Pastian dusanak tau apo nan bisa dunsanak karajoan dan nan bisa dibaok ka dalam dan apo se nan lah disabuikan buliah dibaok malewati bateh sah sacaro jumlah.
eng_text: Make sure you know what you can and cannot bring in and declare anything over the legal limits.

text: Caro nan paliang mudah untuak mamulai usaho dalam bidang panulisan tampek wisata adolah maasah kamampuan nan padek dalam manulih website dan blog.
eng_text: The easiest way to get started in the business of travel writing is to hone your skills on an established travel blog website.

text: Sasudah dunsanak maraso nyaman mambantuak jo maatur di web, siap itu, bisa mambuek website surang.
eng_text: After you become comfortable with formatting and editing on the web, then later, you might create your own website.

text: Manjadi relawan salamo pajalanan adolah caro nan paliang tapek untuak mambuek parubahan nan labiah dari sakadar baragiah.
eng_text: Volunteering while travelling is a great way to make a difference but it's not just about giving.

text: Tingga dan manjadi relawan di nagari asiang adolah caro nan tapek untuak baraja budaya baru, basobok jo urang baru, mangenal paribadi surang, dan mandapek an caro pandang dan maasah katarampilan baru.
eng_text: Living and volunteering in a foreign country is a great way to get to know a different culture, meet new people, learn about yourself, get a sense of perspective and even gain new skills.

text: Itu bisa juo manjadi caro nan rancak untuak mancukuikan biaya iduik untuak tingga labiah lamo dima sajo karano banyak karajo relawan manyadiokan tampek tingga jo makan jo saketek upah.
eng_text: It can also be a good way to stretch a budget to allow a longer stay somewhere since many volunteer jobs provide room and board and a few pay a small salary.

text: Kapa Viking tu malewati jalur lauik Rusia untuak sampai di Lauik Hitam jo Lauik Kaspia. Sabagian gadang dari jalur ko bisa ditampuah. Harus dipareso apo nan diparaluan untuak mandapek an izin lalu, kamungkinan agak payah untuak maurus izinnyo.
eng_text: Vikings used the Russian waterways to get to the Black Sea and Caspian Sea. Parts of these routes can still be used. Check possible need for special permits, which may be difficult to get.

text: Kanal Baltik di Lauik Putiah maubuangan Lautan Laweh Arktik jo Lauik Baltik malalui Danau Onega, Danau Ladoga dan Saint Petersburg, banyak malalui sungai dan danau.
eng_text: The White Sea–Baltic Canal connects the Arctic Ocean to the Baltic Sea, via Lake Onega, Lake Ladoga and Saint Petersburg, mostly by rivers and lakes.

text: Danau Onega taubuang juo jo Volga, jadi mamakai jalur dari Lauik Kaspia masih mamungkinan untuak malalui Rusia.
eng_text: Lake Onega is also connected to Volga, so coming from the Caspian Sea through Russia is still possible.

text: Pacayo lah dunsanak katiko sampai di marina sagalo manjadi sangaik jaleh. Dunsanak akan basobok jo panumpang lainnyo dan bisa saliang babagi informasi.
eng_text: Be assured that once you hit the marinas everything will be pretty obvious. You will meet other boat hitchhikers and they will share their information with you.

text: Pado dasarnyo dunsanak akan maagiah tau ka urang untuak manggunaan jasa bantuan dunsanak, ilia mudiak di palabuahan, mandakek an urang nan sadang mambarasihan kapa pasiarnyo, mancubo mangecek jo palauik di bar dan lain sabagainyo.
eng_text: Basically you'll be putting up notices offering your help, pacing the docks, approaching people cleaning their yachts, trying to make contact with sailors in the bar, etc.

text: Cubolah untuak mangecek jo sabanyak mungkin urang. Satalah babarapo saaik urang-urang nan lah dakek jo dunsanak akan maagiah tau dima kapa nan mambutuhan urang.
eng_text: Try to talk to as many people as possible. After a while everyone will know you and will give you hints as to which boat is looking for someone.

text: Untuak hati-hatinyo dunsanak rancak mamiliah panabangan Frequent Flyer.
eng_text: You should choose your Frequent Flyer airline in an alliance carefully.

text: Maskipun dunsanak acok tabang jo panabangan nan salamo ko dunsanak pilih, dunsanak haruih bapangana lo baaso parilaku tatantu acok bana babeda dan panabangan Frequent Flyer mungkin babeda dari panabangan dari alinasi nan samo.
eng_text: Although you may think it is intuitive to join the airline you fly most, you should be aware that privileges offered are often different and frequent flyer points may be more generous under a different airline in the same alliance.

text: Maskapai takah Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways & Turkish Airlines alah mampalaweh palayanannyo sampai ka Afrika, dan alah bakarajo samo lo samo kota kota gadang di Afrika jo harago nan basaiang jo panabangan Eropa lainnyo.
eng_text: Airlines such as Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways & Turkish Airlines have greatly expanded their services to Africa, and offer connections to many major African cities at competitive rates than other European airlines.

text: Turki Airlines tabang di 39 tujuan di 30 tampek di Negara Afrika pado tahun 2014.
eng_text: Turkish Airlines flies to 39 destinations in 30 African countries as of 2014.

text: Jikok dunsanak ado wakatu untuak bapaian, cubo caliak bara tarif panawaran ka Afrika dibandiangan kaliliang dunia.
eng_text: If you have additional travel time, check to see how your total fare quote to Africa compares with a round-the-world fare.

text: Jan lupo untuak mamasuakan biaya tambahan dari visa tambahan, pajak kabarangkekan, kandaraan darek, jo lain sabagainyo untuak sadoalah tampek-tampek di lua Afrika.
eng_text: Don't forget to add in the extra costs of additional visas, departure taxes, ground transportation, etc. for all those places outside of Africa.

text: Jikok dunsanak nio naik kapa tabang mangalilingan Bagian Salatan bumi, pilihan panabangan dan tujuannyo sangaik tabateh karano kurangnyo rute lalu linteh di udaro.
eng_text: If you want to fly around the world completely in the Southern Hemisphere, the choice of flights and destinations is limited due to the lack of transoceanic routes.

text: Indak ado panabangan nan mancangkuik tigo panyubarangan jalua lauik di salatan bumi (dan bahkan SkyTeam indak mancangkuik panyubarangan tu).
eng_text: No airline alliance covers all three ocean crossings in the Southern Hemisphere (and SkyTeam covers none of the crossings).

text: Namun, Star Alliance mancangkuik sadoannyo kacuali pasifik salatan dari bagian timua Santiago de Chile ka Tahiti nan marupokan panabangan LATAM Oneworld.
eng_text: However, Star Alliance covers everything except the eastern South Pacific from Santiago de Chile to Tahiti, which is a LATAM Oneworld flight.

text: Panabangan ko indak satu-satunyo nan dipiliah jikok dunsanak nio malewati Pasifik Salatan dan pantai baraik Amerika Salatan. (liek di bawah)
eng_text: This flight is not the only option if you want to skip the South Pacific and the west coast of South America. (see below)

text: Di taun 1994, wilayah etnis Armenia Nagorno-Karabakh di Azerbaijan mangobarkan parang malawan Azeri.
eng_text: In 1994, the ethnically Armenian Nagorno-Karabakh region of Azerbaijan waged war against the Azeris.

text: Jo dukuangan urang Armenia, suatu republik baru alah dibuek. Namun, indak ado nagara mapan - bahkan Armenia - nan sacaro resmi mangakuinyo.
eng_text: With Armenian backing, a new republic was created. However, no established nation - not even Armenia - officially recognizes it.

text: Pandapek diplomatik ateh wilayah nan tu taruih marusak hubuangan Armenia jo Azerbaijan.
eng_text: Diplomatic arguments over the region continue to mar relations between Armenia and Azerbaijan.

text: Distrik Kanal (Balando: Grachtengordel) adolah distrik tanamo di abaik 17 nan mangaliliangi Binnenstad Amsterdam.
eng_text: The Canal District (Dutch: Grachtengordel) is the famous 17th-century district surrounding the Binnenstad of Amsterdam.

text: Kasaluruahan distrik tu dibangun sabagai situs Warisan Adat Dunia UNESCO sabab adatnyo nan unik dan nilai sejarahnyo, dan propertinyo banilai tatinggi di saluruah nagari tu.
eng_text: The whole district is designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site for its unique cultural and historical value, and its property values are among the highest of the country.

text: Cinque Terre, nan artinyo 5 Tanah, tadiri dari 5 desa pasisia ketek nan namonyo Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza dan Monterosso nan talatak di wilayah Itali di Liguria.
eng_text: Cinque Terre, which means Five Lands, comprises the five small coastal villages of Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza and Monterosso located in the Italian region of Liguria.

text: Kampuang tu lah tadaftar di Warisan Adat Dunia Unesco.
eng_text: They are listed on the UNESCO World Heritage List.

text: Salamo labiah dari saabaik, urang-urang sacaro bahati-hati mambangun teras di dataran nan kasa, lanskap curam di tabiang nan maadok ka lauik.
eng_text: Over the centuries, people have carefully built terraces on the rugged, steep landscape right up to the cliffs that overlook the sea.

text: Bagian dari dayo pukau adolah kurangnyo pambangunan parusahaan yang tampak. Jalan satapak, kareta api dan biduak mahubuangkan lampuang-kampuang, dan oto indak bisa mancapai tampek tu dari lua.
eng_text: Part of its charm is the lack of visible corporate development. Paths, trains and boats connect the villages, and cars cannot reach them from the outside.

text: Ragam dari bahaso Prancis nan ditutuaan di Belgia dan Swiss babeda salayang dari bahaso Prancis asli, walau bahaso tu sacaro bunyi tadanga sarupo.
eng_text: The varieties of French which are spoken in Belgium and Switzerland differ slightly from the French spoken in France, though they are similar enough to be mutually intelligible.

text: Sacaro khusus, sistem angko dari bahaso tutua Belgia dan Swiss punyo kaunikannyo surang nan babeda dari bahaso Prancis nan ditutuaan di Prancis, dan caro manyabuik kato-kato tatantu agak babeda saketek.
eng_text: In particular, the numbering system in French-speaking Belgium and Switzerland has some slight peculiarities that are different from the French spoken in France, and the pronunciation of some words is slightly different.

text: Namun, sado panutua bahaso Prancis dari Belgia dan Swiss pasti alah baraja bahaso Prancis pokok di sakolahnyo, jadi pasti urang tu akan bisa ngarati jo dunsanak walaupun dunsanak manggunoan sistem angko Prancis pokok.
eng_text: Nevertheless, all French-speaking Belgians and Swiss would have learned standard French in school, so they would be able to understand you even if you used the standard French numbering system.

text: Di banyak bagian di dunia, malambai adolah garik ramah, nan artinyo "halo."
eng_text: In many parts of the world, waving is a friendly gesture, indicating "hello."

text: Namun, di Malaysia, paliang indak di antaro urang Malay di kampuang, artinyo adolah "singgahlah", samo jo jari tunjuak ka arah badan, garik nan digunoan di babarapo nagara di barek, dan saharuihnyo digunoan untuak tujuan tu.
eng_text: However, in Malaysia, at least among the Malays in rural areas, it means "come over," similar to the index finger bent toward the body, a gesture which is used in certain Western countries, and should be used only for that purpose.

text: Damikian pulo, panjalajah Inggris di Spanyol mungkin salah maartian lambaian bapisah nan tapak tangan maadok ka palambai (daripado ka arah urang nan dilambaian) sabagai garik nan artinyo maimbau baliak.
eng_text: Similarly, a British traveller in Spain may mistake a wave goodbye involving the palm facing the waver (rather than the person being waved at) as a gesture to come back.

text: Bahaso Parantaro Internasional adolah bahaso artifisial atau bahaso nan dibangun jo tujuan untuak mawadahi komunikasi antaro urang nan mungkin ka sulik untuak bakomunikasi.
eng_text: Auxiliary languages are artificial or constructed languages created with the intent of facilitating communication between peoples who would otherwise have difficulty communicating.

text: Bahaso tu tapisah jo lingua francas, bahaso nan alami dan organik nan manjadi dominan untuak ciek alasan atau alasan lain sabagai mukasuik sabananyo dari komunikasi antaro panutua dari bahaso lain.
eng_text: They are separate from lingua francas, which are natural or organic languages that become dominant for one reason or another as means of communication between speakers of other languages.

text: Di angek siang hari, wisatawan bisa marasoan fatamorgana nan mambuek ilusi bantuak aia (atau bisa juo hal lain).
eng_text: In the heat of the day, travelers can experience mirages that give the illusion of water (or other things).

text: Iko bisa babahayo jikok turis mangaja bayangan tu, mambuang-buang tanago nan baharago jo siso aia.
eng_text: These can be dangerous if the traveler pursue the mirage, wasting precious energy and remaining water.

text: Bahkan padang pasia paliang angek bisa manjadi sabana dingin jikok malam. Hipotermia adolah ancaman nan nyato kalau indak ado baju angek.
eng_text: Even the hottest of deserts can become extremely cold at night. Hypothermia is a real risk without warm clothing.

text: Di musim angek, khususnyo, dunsanak haruih mamparatian rangik kalau dunsanak nio bajalan malewati utan hujan.
eng_text: In summer, especially, you'll need to watch out for mosquitoes if you decide to hike through the rainforest.

text: Bahkan jikok dunsanak manyetir malewati utan hujan subtropis, rangik akan masuak kadalam oto walau pintu dibukak babarapo datiak.
eng_text: Even if you're driving through the subtropical rainforest, a few seconds with the doors open while you get inside the vehicle is enough time for mosquitoes to get in the vehicle with you.

text: Plu buruang, atau labiah sahnyo avian influenza, bisa manular ka buruang jo mamalia.
eng_text: Bird flu, or more formally avian influenza, can infect both birds and mammals.

text: Kurang dari saribu kasus nan dilaporan tajadi di manusia, tapi babarapo adolah kajadian fatal.
eng_text: Fewer than a thousand cases have ever been reported in humans, but some of them have been fatal.

text: Banyak nan malibaikan urang-urang nan bakarajo di industri unggeh, dan ado risiko juo untuak pamantau buruang.
eng_text: Most have involved people who work with poultry, but there is also some risk to birdwatchers.

text: Nan khas dari Norwegia adolah taluak jo lambah curam nan tibo-tibo mancaliakan dataran tinggi atau dataran labiah randah.
eng_text: Typical for Norway are steep fjords and valleys that suddenly give way to a high, more or less even plateau.

text: Dataran-dataran tinggi ko acok disabuik juo jo namo "vidde" artinyo sasuatu nan laweh, ranah tabantang nan indak bapokok kayu, sabuah bidang laweh tak babateh.
eng_text: These plateaus are often referred to as "vidde" meaning a wide, open treeless space, a boundless expanse.

text: Di Rogaland jo Agder urang-urang biasonyo manyabuik "hei" untuak padang nan indak babatang kayu nan acok tatutuik samak.
eng_text: In Rogaland and Agder they are usually called "hei" meaning a treeless moorland often covered in heather.

text: Gletser indaklah stabil, tapi mangaliar manuruni bukik. Hal ko akan maakibaikan ratak, jurang, nan bisa tasuruak dek jambatan salju.
eng_text: The glaciers are not stable, but flow down the mountain. This will cause cracks, crevasses, which may be obscured by snow bridges.

text: Dindiang-dindiang jo atok gua es bisa runtuah dan ratakan bisa tatutuik.
eng_text: The walls and roofs of ice caves can collapse and cracks can get closed.

text: Di ujuang gletser bongkahan gadang lapeh, runtuah dan mungkin malompek atau manggalindiang manjauah dari ujuang.
eng_text: At the edge of glaciers huge blocks break loose, fall down and perhaps jump or roll farther from the edge.

text: Musim jalan-jalan untuak stasiun bukik biasonyo malonjak salamo musim paneh India.
eng_text: The tourist season for the hill stations generally peaks during the Indian summer.

text: Maskipun, inyo punyo kaindahan nan babeda jo pasona salamo musim dingin, dangan banyaknyo stasiun bukik nan manarimo sabanyak itu salju jo manawaran kagiatan sarupo ski jo basiluncua salju.
eng_text: However, they have a different kind of beauty and charm during winter, with many hill stations receiving healthy amounts of snow and offering activities such as skiing and snowboarding.

text: Hanyo babarapo maskapai nan masih manawarkan ongkoih kamalangan, nan maagiah saketek potongan arago untuak datiak taakhia pajalanan manjanguak.
eng_text: Only a few airlines still offer bereavement fares, which slightly discount the cost of last-minute funeral travel.

text: Maskapai nan manawarkan iko tamasuak Air Canada, Delta Air Lines, Lufthansa untuak panarbangan barasa dari AS atau Kanada, sarato jo WestJet.
eng_text: Airlines that offer these include Air Canada, Delta Air Lines, Lufthansa for flights originating from the U.S. or Canada, and WestJet.

text: Dalam satiok situasi, dunsanak paralu mamasan malalui talepon langsuang ka maskapai.
eng_text: In all cases, you must book by phone directly with the airline.
